context.description: Founded in April 2011, the East African Institute of Homecare Management (EAIHM) is strategically located in Githurai 45, Nairobi, offering a spacious learning environment on one acre of land. The institute provides a unique curriculum developed in collaboration with the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development and the National Industrial Training Authority, aimed at creating professionals in Homecare Management and the wider Hospitality industry for the East African community and beyond. EAIHM has expanded its course offerings to include Catering, Hairdressing and Beauty, Fashion and Design, Early Childhood Development, Business Studies, Languages, and Information Technology. As a social enterprise, EAIHM partners with NGOs to tailor courses for marginalized groups, including out-of-school youth, women, and refugees, with a focus on life skills, communication, and labor relations. All programs include mandatory industrial attachments, ensuring hands-on experience before graduation. The institute also offers flexible study options, including regular, evening, and weekend classes. EAIHM adheres to the standards set by the Ministry of Education and is officially registered under certificate number MOHEST/PC/1439/011. It is recognized by TVETA and NITA as trainers, and offers examinations that are examined by NITA and KNEC.

context.description: The East African School of Aviation (EASA) is the training directorate of the Kenya Civil Aviation Authority (KCAA), located on Fedha Road in Embakasi, Nairobi, with its postal address at P.O. Box 30689-00100, Nairobi. The school operates two campuses, Embakasi and Wilson Airport, organised into four academic departments covering Aviation Safety and Security Management, Air Navigation Services, Aviation Business Management, and the Curriculum Development Unit & Research. It trains flight dispatchers, aviation safety and security officers and air navigation services personnel, and offers IATA-certified programmes in cabin crew, airport operations, air cargo, dangerous goods and travel and tourism, alongside KNEC diplomas in aeronautical engineering, information communication technology and telecommunication engineering. Beyond Kenya, EASA has trained personnel from countries including Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Ghana, South Africa and Nigeria, and lists partnerships with ICAO, IATA, Singapore Aviation Academy, Incheon Airport Aviation Academy, AATO, KENET and Moi University. Online course application, student, lecturer, library and e-learning portals support its training delivery, with specialised e-learning offered in aviation business management, aviation safety and security management and air navigation services.

context.description: Ebukanga Technical and Vocational College (Ebukanga TVC) is located at Ebukanga in Vihiga County and presents itself as a centre of excellence committed to providing quality technical and vocational training that equips learners with practical skills for industry and entrepreneurship. Its teaching departments are mechanical and automotive engineering, building and construction technology, electrical and electronics engineering, ICT, liberal studies, business studies, hospitality and tourism, cosmetology, and agriculture, and it publishes programmes from Competency-Based Education and Training Level 3 to Level 6 alongside industrial attachment. about: Ebukanga Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college in Vihiga County, Western Kenya. It delivers competency-based training from Level 3 to Level 6 through departments covering mechanical and automotive engineering, building and civil engineering, electrical and electronics, computing and informatics, liberal studies, business studies, social work, hospitality and food, cosmetology and fashion, and agriculture.
description: Ebukanga Technical and Vocational College (Ebukanga TVC) is located at Ebukanga in Vihiga County and presents itself as a centre of excellence committed to providing quality technical and vocational training that equips learners with practical skills for industry and entrepreneurship. Its teaching departments are mechanical and automotive engineering, building and construction technology, electrical and electronics engineering, ICT, liberal studies, business studies, hospitality and tourism, cosmetology, and agriculture, and it publishes programmes from Competency-Based Education and Training Level 3 to Level 6 alongside industrial attachment. The college states a vision to be a leading institution in TVET training that transforms communities through skill development and innovation, a mission to empower students with practical skills, discipline and innovation, and core values of integrity, innovation, inclusivity, excellence and teamwork. Admission runs through an online application form, and the college advertises government sponsorship through KUCCPS as well as HELB and county bursary support. Published entry guidance states that Level 6 requires KCSE mean grade C-, Level 5 requires D and Level 4 requires D-, while Level 3 applicants may use KCPE qualifications.

context.description: Egerton University's own records state that it was founded as a farm school in 1939 by Lord Maurice Egerton of Tatton and upgraded to an agricultural college in 1950. It was established as a university through the Egerton University Act of 1987 and was chartered afresh in 2013, and the Commission for University Education lists it among Kenya's public chartered universities. The university teaches through ten faculties across two principal campuses, the Njoro main campus and the Nakuru Town Campus College, together with an E-Campus, Kenyatta Campus and Mpeketoni Campus, and its fact sheet records 19 diploma, 56 bachelor's, 67 master's and 50 doctorate programmes with a 2024/2025 undergraduate enrolment of 5,668 students. Its E-Campus runs a live Moodle learning management system at https://elearning.egerton.ac.ke through which in-session students access course materials with online module facilitators. The university also maintains student, staff and parents portals and is ISO 9001:2015 certified, with a library listed among its academic and research services.

The regulator records it in Uasin Gishu County with a licence current to 1 July 2029 and the status 'Registered and Licensed'. Its accredited programme table is one of the broadest in the register: KASNEB accountancy awards, an IATA diploma in Airport Operations and Flight Dispatch, KNEC artisan trade courses in electrical installation, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, plumbing, salesmanship, storekeeping and welding and fabrication, sixteen KNEC craft certificates spanning accountancy, banking, building, business, co-operative management, electrical technology, ICT, land surveying, library studies, mechanical engineering, sales and marketing, secretarial studies, social development and water technology, and twenty-three KNEC diplomas in accountancy, agricultural engineering, architecture, automotive engineering, business management, civil engineering, computer studies, electrical and electronics engineering in power and telecommunications, entrepreneurial agriculture, environmental science, food and beverage management, ICT, information studies, land surveying, nutrition and dietetics, petroleum and project management, quantity surveying, sales and marketing, secretarial studies, social work and supply chain management. The register repeats several rows and pairs identical course names at craft and diploma levels, so entries have been de-duplicated and level-qualified where the same title appears twice. The KASNEB Certified Public Accountants qualification is listed as a professional award that has no equivalent level in the Schologic vocabulary and is therefore recorded here only. The institute's own contact page, fetched live, publishes the Mid Town offices as Telkom/Orange House in Eldoret together with the branch office at Petresha/Berur Business Center and the ETTI driving school, lists its postal address as P.O. description: Eldoret Technical Training Institute - Mid Town Campus is a private Technical and Vocational College registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 19 June 2017 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0093/2017. The regulator records it in Uasin Gishu County with a licence current to 1 July 2029 and the status 'Registered and Licensed'. Its accredited programme table is one of the broadest in the register: KASNEB accountancy awards, an IATA diploma in Airport Operations and Flight Dispatch, KNEC artisan trade courses in electrical installation, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, plumbing, salesmanship, storekeeping and welding and fabrication, sixteen KNEC craft certificates spanning accountancy, banking, building, business, co-operative management, electrical technology, ICT, land surveying, library studies, mechanical engineering, sales and marketing, secretarial studies, social development and water technology, and twenty-three KNEC diplomas in accountancy, agricultural engineering, architecture, automotive engineering, business management, civil engineering, computer studies, electrical and electronics engineering in power and telecommunications, entrepreneurial agriculture, environmental science, food and beverage management, ICT, information studies, land surveying, nutrition and dietetics, petroleum and project management, quantity surveying, sales and marketing, secretarial studies, social work and supply chain management. The register repeats several rows and pairs identical course names at craft and diploma levels, so entries have been de-duplicated and level-qualified where the same title appears twice. The KASNEB Certified Public Accountants qualification is listed as a professional award that has no equivalent level in the Schologic vocabulary and is therefore recorded here only. The institute's own contact page, fetched live, publishes the Mid Town offices as Telkom/Orange House in Eldoret together with the branch office at Petresha/Berur Business Center and the ETTI driving school, lists its postal address as P.O. Box 770-30100 Eldoret, and gives the telephone line 0725 818 644 and the mailbox eldtti@yahoo.com, so the Mid Town Campus is recorded in Eldoret town, Uasin Gishu County.

context.description: ELS Hospitality Training Center is a private hospitality training institution that began operating in September 2020 with the stated mission of bringing modern, practical hospitality education to Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registers it as a Technical and Vocational College under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0185/2025, and the institution states it is accredited to offer ICM and UK qualifications. name: Embulbul Educational and Counseling Centre

context.about: Embulbul Educational and Counseling Centre is a private Technical and Vocational College in Kajiado County, Kenya, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0188/2016 with a licence valid to 19 January 2029. It specialises in counselling training, offering Kenya National Examinations Council diplomas in counselling specialisms and competency-based counselling psychology awards at levels 5 and 6. The centre describes itself as a Catholic-based institution and an affiliate of the Catholic University of Eastern Africa, and its own site publishes the postal address 24023 Ngong', Karen, Nairobi 00502 and the telephone line +254-720-757456.
context.description: Embulbul Educational and Counseling Centre is a private TVET institution operating in Kajiado County, Kenya, and concentrates on counselling and psychological support training. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority lists it in the accredited-institution register as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0188/2016, a private Technical and Vocational College whose licence runs to 19 January 2029 with the status Registered and Licensed. Its published course table combines three Kenya National Examinations Council diplomas, a general counselling diploma and diplomas with marriage and family therapy and child and adolescent counselling specialisms, with competency-based counselling psychology awards examined by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council at level 5 and level 6, corresponding to certificate and diploma stages. The centre's own site at eecc.ac.ke was fetched live and identifies the institution as Embulbul Education and Counselling Centre, an affiliate of the Catholic University of Eastern Africa, describing itself as a Catholic-based provider of education, counselling and psychosocial services across Kenya and East Africa. That site's contact block publishes info@eecc.ac.ke, the telephone line +254-720-757456 and the postal address 24023 Ngong', Karen, Nairobi 00502, so the centre's settlement is recorded as Ngong in Kajiado County, the county the regulator records for the licence. No e-learning or distance-learning provision is recorded for the centre.

The register's course table carries twenty-one awards after de-duplication on course, level and examining body: seven KNEC awards (two artisan trades in masonry and plumbing, four craft awards in general agriculture, human resource management, information communication technology and supply chain management, and one diploma in human resource management) and fourteen competency-based awards examined by TVET CDACC at Levels 4, 5 and 6. Box 345-30300 Kapsabet, its location as off the Kapsabet-Nairobi road, the telephone line 0112332525 and the mailbox eemgwentvc@gmail.com, which places the college at Kapsabet in Nandi County. The register itself publishes no website, e-mail address or telephone number for the college, so those identity values are taken from the college's own site and archived capture.

context.about: Emurua Dikirr Technical Training Institute is a public technical training institute in Narok County registered and licensed by the TVET Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0011/2021. context.description: Emurua Dikirr Technical Training Institute is a public technical training institute in Narok County, registered and licensed by the TVET Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0011/2021. Its registration date is 28 January 2021 and the licence remains valid until 17 March 2031. The accredited course table is unusually broad for a sub-county institute, spanning artisan trade tests, KNEC craft and diploma awards, and Level 3 to Level 6 competency-based programmes under the TVET CDACC. The register lists fifty-four rows that de-duplicate to fifty-three distinct awards once a repeated artisan motor vehicle mechanics entry is removed. Subject coverage includes automotive and mechanical engineering, building and civil engineering, electrical and electronics, agriculture, business and secretarial studies, ICT, science laboratory technology, social development, and tourism and tour guiding. The institute's inherited website address edtti.ac.ke did not respond when fetched on 25 October 2026, so it is not recorded as a verified website.

context.description: Endebess Technical Training Institute is a public technical and vocational college located in Endebess, Trans Nzoia County, registered and licensed by TVETA under TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0013/2023. According to the principal, Mr Daniel Kakusha Kamatei, the institute offers Level 6 (Diploma), Level 5 (Craft), Level 4 and Level 3 (Artisan) courses in agriculture, applied sciences, engineering, business and ICT, all framed as competence-based, practically oriented training. The principal's message reports strong KNEC examination performance, rising from 54% in November 2018 to 86% in November 2019, and states that students are supervised and assessed during compulsory industrial attachment. The institute maintains an online admission portal, online fee payment via eCitizen and a Moodle-based e-learning portal at elearning.endebesstechnical.ac.ke, and is listed by KUCCPS for government-sponsored placement.

context.about: Equip Africa Institute - Nakuru Campus is a private technical and vocational college in Nakuru County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0014/2021 with a licence valid to 2 February 2031. It is one of the wider private TVC course tables in the register, combining KNEC artisan, craft and diploma awards in business and supply chain with 39 TVET CDACC competency-based awards from level 4 to level 6 in agriculture, agribusiness, health, social work, ICT, security, journalism and management.
context.description: Equip Africa Institute - Nakuru Campus is a private TVC recorded in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0014/2021, registered on 28 January 2021 with a licence valid to 2 February 2031 under the status registered and licensed. The register places it in Nakuru County, in Kenya's Rift Valley region. Its accredited table carries forty-five awards: one KNEC artisan award in salesmanship, three KNEC craft programmes in accountancy, sales and marketing and supply chain management, two KNEC diplomas in accountancy and supply chain management, and thirty-nine TVET CDACC competency-based awards split between eleven level 4, eighteen level 5 and ten level 6 programmes. The CDACC range is unusually broad for a private college, covering agriculture extension, agripreneurship, apiculture, aquaculture, dairy and poultry operations, horticulture, community health, social work, security guarding, business management, marketing, human resource management, supply chain, tour and travel, ICT, cyber security, animation and digital media, broadcast journalism, counselling psychology, criminal justice management and public administration. Register levels were normalised to the schema vocabulary, with Craft rendered as Certificate, CDACC level 4 as Artisan, level 5 as Certificate and level 6 as Diploma. The register publishes no street address, postal address, telephone line or institutional email for the campus, and no institution-owned website was confirmed in this pass, so those fields are recorded as absent rather than estimated.

context.description: Equip Africa Institute – Mombasa is a private TVET college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0044/2021, first registered on 26 April 2021 with a licence valid to 17 July 2031. The campus operates from MKU Plaza on Nkrumah Road in Mombasa (postal address P.O. Box 42702-80100 Mombasa as printed on an independent education listing, with a plot reference MOMBASA/BLOCK XXIV/21) and traces its origin to a Mount Kenya University campus established in 2008, with the TVET unit launching its first business and technical programmes in 2021; it currently teaches diploma, certificate and artisan programmes under four departments (hospitality/tourism/travel, business and social sciences, computing and informatics, health and social sciences) with KASNEB, KNEC and TVET CDACC examinations, and the independent listing also prints ABE business courses and a KASNEB Certified Public Accountant row beyond the register's 41 entries. Mount Kenya University's own website lists Equip Africa Institute as a TVET-accredited institute founded in 2016 whose centre of excellence sits at MKU Thika main campus along General Kago Road, with campuses in Kisii, Mombasa and Nakuru in operation. Equip Africa's Mombasa campus page and shared institutional footer publish phone +254 709 153 205, email info@eai.ac.ke, a shared student portal at studentportal.mku.ac.ke, a staff portal, MKU library, online application, careers and payment pages and social channels on Facebook, YouTube, X and TikTok; accrediting three hospitality-department diploma/certificate/artisan course clusters with KNQA-recognised entry requirements and per-term fee listings. No distance-learning or e-learning delivery is published at the campus level, and no named campus officer with a direct contact route could be verified, so no personal contact is recorded.

context.description: The institute's own website states that Equip Africa Institute is the TVET arm of Mount Kenya University, that it is fully accredited by TVETA, and that its campuses are Thika, Nairobi, Nakuru, Mombasa, Kitale, Malindi and Kisii, with training offered at Diploma, Certificate and Artisan level. The TVETA register records this centre under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0005/2023, registered on 26 January 2023 and licensed to 25 January 2028, with status 'Registered and Licensed', classified as a private TVC in Kilifi County. Thirty programme rows are registered for the centre, ranging from Level 3 artisan trades through Level 5 diplomas to Level 6 higher diplomas, all assessed by TVET CDACC; because eight titles recur across two or three levels, the CDACC level is carried in each course label. The published email address and telephone number are the institute's headquarters contacts in Thika, as the Malindi centre publishes no separate direct line. Unrelated commercial text has been injected into the body of the institute's homepage around an intact institutional header, so only the header, programme and contact content was used as evidence.

context.description: Exiera Medical Training College - Rongo is a private Technical and Vocational College registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0155/2024, with registration dated 29 October 2024 and a licence running to 28 October 2029. The college operates in Rongo, Migori County, and forms part of a small Exiera network whose Kisumu branch (Exiera Medical College - Kisumu, TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0154/2024) and Kericho branch (Exiera Medical Training College Kericho, TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0272/2025) hold separate TVETA registrations. A Google Places listing matched to the college shows it as operational, with the telephone line +254 790 984771 and a Facebook page (facebook.com/exieramtc) given as its web presence, while the college's former website exieramtc.org has expired. A third-party foundation blog describes Exiera Medical Training College as a proud affiliate of Excella Medical Hospitals International offering high-quality, hands-on training.

context.about: Finetune School of Music is a private music school in Kiambu Town, Kiambu County, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0036/2021, teaching instrumental performance, voice, dance and deejaying to students of all ages in its own studios.
context.description: Finetune School of Music teaches instrumental and vocal music in Kiambu Town under registration TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0036/2021. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered the school on 26 April 2021 with a licence running to 30 June 2031 and the status 'Registered Only'. Instruction covers piano, guitar, violin, saxophone, drumming, voice coaching and singing, dance and deejaying, with tuition offered to beginners and advanced students of all ages. The school describes equipped studios for audio recording and music video production and a boarding facility, and its instrumental and dance lessons are proficiency-based, certificated in-house rather than examined by KNEC, CDACC or NITA.

context.description: First American Health Institute, trading as FAHI-Kenya, is a private health-training institution whose Nairobi campus is registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as a Technical and Vocational College under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0216/2025, registered on 6 November 2025 and licensed to 5 November 2030 with status Registered and Licensed. The institute occupies House No. 6 on the first floor of the New Shell Service Station Building near Royal Victory Hospital on Outering Road, and it publishes additional offices in Voi (Taita Taveta County) and Mombasa (Mombasa County). The TVETA register lists four CDACC-examined programmes for the Nairobi campus: Caregiving at Level 4, and Community Health, Healthcare Support Services and Perioperative Theatre Technology, all at Level 5. On its own website the institute advertises a wider portfolio that it says includes a flagship Certified Nursing Assistant and Healthcare Support Assistant programme with a clinical hospital attachment, emergency medical technician training, phlebotomy, mortuary sciences, a Diploma in Nursing described as KNQF Level 6, IELTS and ASCPi examination preparation, and short courses in BLS, ACLS and first aid; those additional awards are published by the institute but are not yet reflected in the regulator's course table. The institute also offers hybrid, full-virtual and face-to-face learning modules and operates a home-based care agency and staffing service alongside its training arm. Its site states TVETA registration details as TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0014/2024, which does not match the registration number recorded for the Nairobi campus in the TVETA register, and the regulator's record is treated as authoritative here.

context.description: Frontier Institute of Professional and Management Studies is a private technical and vocational college registered with TVETA under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0062/2021 and licensed to operate in Wajir County until 4 August 2031. Its Wajir campus sits along Wajir International Airport Road, opposite Soko Mjinga in Wajir town, and features modern ICT laboratories, a comprehensive library and spacious lecture halls; the institution's website also lists a campus in Garissa Town. Its website additionally advertises degree-level programmes in computer science, business information technology and community health, promoted alongside Great Lakes University.

context.about: Fusion Skills Technical College is a private technical and vocational college registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0069/2025 and listed by the regulator in Meru County. It trains at CDACC competency-based levels four and five in automotive, cosmetology, fashion, hospitality and ICT, and its own website describes the campus at Farm City along the Isiolo-Meru Highway.
context.description: Fusion Skills Technical College appears in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as a private technical and vocational college registered under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0069/2025 on 25 April 2025, with a licence running to 24 April 2030 and a status of Registered and Licensed. The regulator lists the college in Meru County and records six accredited programmes at TVET CDACC level four and level five, covering motor vehicle mechanics, cosmetology, accommodation operations, fashion design technology, catering and accommodation operations, and information communication technology. The college's own website, fusiontech.ac.ke, presents the institution as offering diploma, certificate and artisan programmes and states that teaching is hands-on and career-focused; its contact page gives the physical address as the Farm City area along the Isiolo-Meru Highway. That page also describes the college as being in Isiolo, while the TVETA register places it in Meru County, so the regulator's county is retained here and the discrepancy is recorded rather than silently resolved. The college's contact page publishes info@fusiontech.ac.ke, which is recorded here as the institutional e-mail, and no student population figure is published, so the enrolment count remains unset.
accreditations: TVETA registration TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0069/2025, registered 2025-04-25, licence valid to 2030-04-24, status 'Registered and Licensed'

description: Garissa University TVET Institute is a public technical and vocational college in Garissa County, in Kenya's North Eastern region, and operates as the TVET institute of Garissa University. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered it under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0021/2025 on 6 November 2025 with a licence running to 5 November 2030, and its status on the register is Registered and Licensed. The accredited-award table lists nine CDACC entry rows covering seven distinct qualification names, dominated by level 6 diploma programmes in business management, health records and information technology, human resource management, information communication technology, nutrition and dietetics, public administration and supply chain management, alongside level 5 certificate variants of business management and ICT. All awards are assessed by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council rather than by KNEC. The institute has no separate web presence; the inherited institutional web address is the parent university's domain at gau.ac.ke, which was fetched live and publishes the main campus at P.O. Box 1801-70100, University Way off Kismayu Road, Garissa, the address line recorded here, together with the registrar's telephone line +254713680988, which matches the number carried in the identity column. The register itself publishes no street address, postal address, telephone line or institutional email for the TVET institute, and no institute-specific mailbox is published on the university's page, so basic_info.email remains null.

context.description: Garsen Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0026/2017, with category TVC and a licence valid to 8 October 2028. The regulator's accredited-programme table lists three competency-based entries examined by TVET CDACC — business management at levels 5 and 6 and social work at level 6 — while the Pathrel catalogue additionally records a broader artisan, craft and diploma portfolio spanning building technology, electrical, electronic and mechanical engineering, plumbing, masonry, welding, motor vehicle mechanics and civil engineering. The college is located at Idsowe in the Garsen area of Tana River County and is reported by Pathrel to serve around 750 students from pastoralist and agrarian communities, with a competency-based education and training mission geared to self-employment and the local labour market. Facilities reported on the Pathrel page include a library with a digital resource centre, engineering workshops, computer laboratories with internet access, sports grounds, student hostels and an agricultural demonstration farm. No institutional website could be reached — the garsen.tvc.ac.ke domain published by Pathrel does not resolve — and the regulator record publishes no e-learning or distance-learning provision.

context.description: Gatanga Technical Vocational College (GTVC) was established in 2017 through funding from the Government of Kenya (GoK) and the Gatanga Constituency Development Fund (NG-CDF). [9, 13] Initially mentored by Michuki Technical Training Institute, the college admitted its first trainees in January 2018, offering courses in Electrical Engineering, ICT, Mechanical, Plumbing, and Hairdressing. [5, 13] GTVC has since grown significantly, from a population of 150 trainees in four departments in June 2019 to approximately 1,500 students across eight departments. [5] The institution is recognized as a Centre of Excellence in Mechanical Engineering, having received substantial modern production equipment, computers, and furniture from the Government of Kenya. [5, 13] Its mission is to provide technical and vocational education and training courses that produce skilled and competent manpower capable of competing favorably in the labor market. [9, 13] GTVC's vision is to be a center of excellence in the provision of technical and vocational education and training. [13] The college's motto is 'Technical skills and Innovation for self-reliance and sustainability'. [13, 14]

context.description: Gatanga Technical and Vocational College (GTVC) is a public TVET institution registered and licensed by TVETA under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0035/2018, with the licence running to 2029. The college is located at Ndunyu Chege in Gatanga Constituency, Murang'a County, along the Thika-Ndakaini Road, and admits students in January, May and September intakes. Teaching is organised into departmental units covering Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Hospitality and Institutional Management, Business Studies, Computing and Informatics, Agricultural and Environmental Studies, Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, and Building and Civil Engineering. Programmes span Artisan, Certificate, Diploma and Higher Diploma levels with entry from KCPE to C-minus at KCSE, and are examined by KNEC, TVET CDACC and KASNEB. The college also runs an ODeL (Open, Distance and e-Learning) platform on Moodle at elearning.gatangatvc.ac.ke alongside computer packages training and Jitume sessions.

context.description: The TVET Authority register records Gates Africa Training Centre as a private Technical and Vocational College in Kisumu County under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0015/2024, registered on 25 April 2024 with a licence valid to 24 April 2029 and the status Registered and Licensed. The register lists thirty-eight course rows, which collapse to thirty-five distinct qualifications after repeated rows for beauty therapy, electrical engineering and community health are merged; the spread runs from NITA trade tests and level-3 CDACC certificates up to level-6 higher diplomas in engineering, health records, nutrition, perioperative theatre technology and social work. The GATES website confirms the institution's identity and its Kisumu campus, describing its centres as 'Talent-Based Learning Centres' that teach through talent-based, experiential and traditional academic modes, and reporting that its sponsored African Talent University has become government accredited. Its contact page prints the address info@gatesafrica.org, the line +254 788 193 427 and its Buoye, Mowlem, Kisumu head office, so the e-mail is sourced to that page. No learning-management system or distance-learning portal is published, so both learning-mode fields are recorded as none.

name: Gathuthi Vocational Training Center

context.about: Gathuthi VTC is the primary 'Local Infrastructure Partner' for Tetu Sub-county, serving as a critical source of skilled artisan labor for regional public works and masonry projects.
context.description: Managed by the Nyeri County Government, the center provides affordable, community-based training in trades that have immediate local demand, specifically masonry, garment making, and plumbing. Its unique value lies in its direct partnership with the county, where students often gain practical experience working on local school and market construction projects as part of their training. The center is dedicated to transforming the local economy by producing self-reliant graduates who dominate the regional construction and garment production sectors. It serves as a vital platform for youth in the rural Thegenge region to acquire high-demand vocational skills that support both self-employment and community growth.

context.about: Gatundu South Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college under the Ministry of Education's State Department for TVET, situated at Gatundu Town in Gatundu South Sub-County, Kiambu County, Central region, Kenya. It is registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0032/2019 and offers competency-based artisan, craft and diploma programmes in construction, electrical, business, computing, social work and supply chain management.
context.description: Gatundu South Technical and Vocational College is a public institution under the Ministry of Education's State Department for Technical and Vocational Education and Training, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 7 June 2019 under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0032/2019 with a licence valid to 5 July 2029 in 'Registered and Licensed' status. The TVETA accredited course table lists fifteen course entries, which deduplicate to fourteen qualifications: KNEC artisan, craft and diploma programmes in electrical installation, building technology, information communication technology, business management, civil engineering, human resource management, social work and community development and supply chain management, plus NITA trade-test courses in masonry, electrical wireman, plumbing and pipe fitting, and welding and fabrication. The college website places the campus at Githaruru Estate, Githunguchu Sub-Location, Gatundu Town, about one kilometre from Gatundu Sub-County Hospital and the Gatundu Law Courts, and states that full-time trainees pay a reduced tuition fee of KSh 22,396 per module. It advertises a Dual TVET hybrid course delivered with KSTVET through the dual.kstvet.ac.ke platform, and states that trainees receive free high-speed Wi-Fi on campus. The college's contact page publishes the postal box recorded here and the telephone line printed here; no email address is published on the pages fetched.

context.description: The Geothermal Development Company Training Centre is entered in the TVETA register of accredited institutions as a publicly owned technical and vocational college in Nakuru County under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0022/2025, with licence status 'Registered and Licensed' expiring on 5 November 2030. Its parent, the Geothermal Development Company (GDC), is a fully government-owned company formed in 2008 as a Special Purpose Vehicle under the Energy Act No. 12 of 2006 to develop steam fields and sell geothermal steam for electricity generation. The centre's accredited programme table lists six Level 6 competency-based awards assessed by TVET CDACC: Applied Geophysics Technology, Geochemistry Technology, Geology Technology, Power Plant Operations and Maintenance Technology, Reservoir Technology and Steam Systems Technology. Training is anchored at GDC's South Rift presence in Nakuru, where the company maintains an office at Polo Centre on Tom Mboya Street; the inaugural African Geothermal Centre of Excellence (AGCE) geothermal technology certificate course kicked off there with 21 participants from 11 African countries, sponsored by the African Union's Africa Energy Commission in collaboration with UN Environment. GDC's head office is at Kawi House, South C, Nairobi, and its corporate website publishes contact details for both offices.

context.description: Gertrude's Institute of Child Health and Research is recorded in the TVETA register as a private Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0032/2018, with a licence valid to 27 March 2029 and the status Registered and Licensed. The institute states that it is embedded within Gertrude's Children's Hospital, which it describes as the most established tertiary paediatric referral and teaching hospital in Eastern and Central Africa, and that since 1999 it has trained more than 3,200 specialised nurses, emergency care providers and paediatric professionals recruited from twelve countries including Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Nigeria and South Sudan. Its published programme ladder runs from a one-year Certificate in Dental Assisting through the NCK-accredited three-year Diploma in Community Health Nursing to higher diploma specialisations in Paediatric Nursing, Paediatric Critical Care Nursing, Paediatric Oncology Nursing and a Higher National Diploma in Neonatal Nursing that the institute lists as commencing in 2027; entry to the neonatal programme requires a registered nurse with one year of post-graduation experience and a valid Nursing Council of Kenya practice licence. It also publishes TVETA-accredited Perioperative Theatre Technology programmes at certificate and diploma level, a Healthcare Support Services Assistant course, an advanced emergency medical technician course and short paediatric resuscitation courses including EPALS, PILS, PALS and paediatric first aid. The neonatal programme is delivered in blended mode, combining face-to-face teaching with online learning, and intakes are advertised for April and September. Training enquiries are handled on +254 709 529 000 and trainingschool@gerties.org; no named officer, student population figure or street address is published on the fetched pages, so those fields are left empty.

context.about: Goma Vocational Training Centre is a private Vocational Training Centre registered by TVETA as TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0015/2024, located at Kamadaga Centre in the Oruba-Ragana area on the outskirts of Migori town, Migori County, Nyanza region. context.description: Goma Vocational Training Centre is a private Vocational Training Centre registered and licensed by TVETA under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0015/2024. The institution is situated at Kamadaga Centre along the Oruba-Nyangubo Road in the Oruba-Ragana area of Migori Town, Migori County. context.description: Goshen Medical & Technical College is a private medical and technical college based at Makongeni in Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered it on 21 October 2020 under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0086/2020, and the registration remains valid to 10 November 2030. The college's own site publishes a course listing covering analytical chemistry, medical engineering at both certificate and diploma level, emergency medical technology, an artisan caregiving programme and a diploma in plumbing technology, while the regulator's accredited course table currently carries a single row for Community Health at Level 6 examined by TVET CDACC; the site does not name examining bodies for the non-CDACC programmes, so they remain unconfirmed rather than guessed. The college also operates a student and parent portal at portal.goshencollege.ac.ke with separate student and parent logins, indicating an online management/learning platform. Teaching is supported by laboratories, a library and an advanced simulation laboratory with high-fidelity manikins, complemented by clinical rotations at partner hospitals and community health centres. The institution's managing director, as published on its homepage, is Dr. Joseph Gichuru.

Green Appoh Beauty College is recorded on the TVETA register as a private Technical and Vocational College in Kiambu County, registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0059/2023, registered 31 July 2023, licence valid to 30 July 2028, status Registered and Licensed. The register publishes no course table for the college, but the college's own active Facebook page (Green Appoh College, page 61581201237253) advertises diploma, certificate and short courses across its schools of cosmetology, beauty therapy, hairdressing and nail technology, plus makeup, barbering, microblading and eyelash installation training, with certificates awarded after completion followed by graduation; no external examination body is advertised, so these awards are recorded as the college's own. The same posts publish the current address as Thika Dream Building, 3rd floor, Makongeni, along the Garissa Highway opposite the Cereal Board of Kenya, Thika, and the contact line 0771 927951, with a second published enrolment number 0722 981 656, all matching or completing the details already held. The stored domain greenappohcollege.ac.ke was retried on this pass and again served no content (retrieval returned HTTP 422 with no page body), so no website claim is made and the domain value is left for the sync stage to review.

context.description: Greenwich College - Garissa is recorded by the TVET Authority as a private Technical and Vocational College in Garissa County, North Eastern region, under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0024/2016, registered on 28 January 2016 and licensed to 12 November 2026 in 'Registered and Licensed' status. The regulator's course table lists twelve qualifications: a KASNEB Accounting Technicians Diploma, seven KNEC craft awards and four KNEC diplomas spanning business, banking and finance, ICT, nutrition, project management, sales and marketing, supply chain management and social work. The college's own website places it at Uchumi Road, 2nd Floor, Uchumi Building, P.O. Box 432-70100, Garissa, and lists academic programmes in business studies and accountancy, social work and community development, hospitality, information technology, and health science, alongside short courses delivered in Arabic and English and tuition for primary and secondary pupils. Its stated vision is to be distinguished by highly regarded programmes and renowned specialisations that transform lives through skills, qualifications and opportunities, with a mission to meet the educational and training needs of its communities. Contacts published on the website are info@greenwichcollege.net and telephone lines +254 711 435 603, +254 729 415 610 and +254 712 716 369, while a +254 20 823201 line is recorded for the college in Google Places.

context.description: Griftu Vocational Training Centre is a county-level public vocational training centre in Griftu, Wajir County, Kenya, operating under the regulatory framework of the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority. TVETA registered it as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0060/2021 on 26 April 2021, and the register snapshot of 25 October 2026 shows a Registered and Licensed status with a licence expiring on 14 August 2031. Its published programme table is entirely artisan-level NITA trade testing, covering Electrical Wireman, Tailoring and Dressmaking. The register entry publishes no institutional website, email address or campus street address; a postal address of P.O. Box 527 - 70200 Griftu and the telephone number 0721431759 appear in a TVETA-derived education directory listing. The institution's land is held on an allotment letter from Wajir County with a Partial Development Plan available and a title deed pending, consistent with county-government ownership of a public VTC.

name: Harbour View Maritime Training Institute

context.about: Harbour View Maritime Training Institute (HVMTI) is a private maritime training institute that provides professional instruction and career development for seafarers. Its published course groups are STCW and ancillary training, security courses, tanker courses, rating and AB courses, and advanced courses, with STCW and ancillary awards certified by the Kenya Maritime Authority.
context.description: Harbour View Maritime Training Institute is a private maritime training institute that describes itself as a centre of maritime learning and innovation whose primary function is providing quality education, professional instruction, career development solutions and training in the maritime sector and related fields. Its course catalogue is organised into five groups: STCW and ancillary training, security courses, tanker courses, rating and AB courses, and advanced courses. The STCW and ancillary group, which the institute states meets international STCW standards, covers STCW Basic Safety (a seven-day mandatory course), STCW Revalidation, Coxswain Level III, Elementary First Aid, Medical Care, Medical First Aid, Personal Survival Techniques, Fire Prevention and Fire Fighting, Personal Safety and Social Responsibility, and a Security Awareness Course, with durations running from one day to fifteen days. Certification bodies are listed per course, with the Kenya Maritime Authority named for most of the STCW and ancillary awards, and published fees for that group range from Ksh 3,500 to Ksh 50,000. Applications are handled through an online form, and the institute publishes a quality policy document and a staff webmail portal.

The college states that it prepares candidates for KASNEB, ICM and CDACC examinations and runs online classes alongside on-campus delivery, and it operates a student portal for examination cards and results. Its registration is independently corroborated by a Kenya Times listing of registered TVET institutions published on 28 September 2026, which places Headway College of Professional Studies among Nairobi County private technical and vocational colleges, so three distinct source hosts are documented: the college's own domain, the TVET Authority register and that news listing. description: Headway College of Professional Studies is listed on the TVET Authority register as a private technical and vocational college under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0130/2025, registered on 29 July 2025 with a licence expiring on 28 July 2030. The college is located at Airport View Plaza on the Eastern Bypass in Embakasi South Constituency, Nairobi, and its own site publishes seven academic schools covering ICT and computer systems, business studies and accountancy, hospitality and tourism, health sciences, journalism and media studies, hairdressing and beauty therapy, and fashion and interior design. Its School of ICT and Computer Systems page publishes a full programme table with course codes, levels, termly and monthly fees, durations and examination bodies, confirming CDACC Level 6 diplomas in computer programming, computer science, cyber security, software engineering and network and system administration, CDACC Level 5 certificates in cyber security and software engineering, NITA computer operator grades I to III, ICDL base, intermediate and advanced modules, and CISCO Networking Academy IT Essentials and CCNA modules 1 to 4. The college states that it prepares candidates for KASNEB, ICM and CDACC examinations and runs online classes alongside on-campus delivery, and it operates a student portal for examination cards and results. Its registration is independently corroborated by a Kenya Times listing of registered TVET institutions published on 28 September 2026, which places Headway College of Professional Studies among Nairobi County private technical and vocational colleges, so three distinct source hosts are documented: the college's own domain, the TVET Authority register and that news listing. No awarding-body listing from CDACC, NITA, ICDL or Cisco naming the college was located to corroborate the programme table independently, and the domain headwaycollege.com does not resolve.

context.description: Helping Hand Skills Development Centre - Malindi is a private vocational training centre entered in the TVET Authority register under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0017/2024, registered on 29 October 2024 and licensed to 28 October 2029, in Kilifi County. The register's course table lists four competency-based awards examined by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council: Computer Operations at Level 3, Electronics at Levels 3 and 4, and Information Communication Technology at Level 4. Under the established batch convention, CDACC Level 3 and Level 4 awards are recorded at the schema level Artisan, so all four entries are Artisan awards, and the two Electronics levels are kept as separate entries because they are distinct qualification levels. The AfricaListings business directory, listing the institution under its exact name in Malindi, Kilifi, records the contact number +254 715 958 880, the Plus Code address Q4P5+QXW Malindi, the web address http://hhrd.or.ke/ and the operating body Helping Hand for Relief and Development Africa, which aligns the centre with the HHRD humanitarian organisation whose Skills Development and Livelihood Centre in Malindi publishes short courses in Henna Art, Computer Skills, Electronics and Refrigeration. The web address did not respond during this research pass, so it is recorded as the published address rather than as a verified live site, and no email address is asserted because none was published by a fetched source.

context.description: Hola Vocational Training Centre is a registered public Vocational Training Centre (VTC) located at Near Makutano, Garsen Garissa Road in Hola, Tana River County, with its premises on the Bura-Hola Road according to Google Maps. The centre is owned by the Tana River County Government, which operates a total of eight vocational training centres in the county. It offers trade courses examined by NITA and KNEC, including arc welding, fashion design and garment making, tailoring and dressmaking, masonry, carpentry and joinery, and motor vehicle technology and mechanics, with capped trainee numbers per course. In 2021 the Tana River County Government announced a KES 10 million Youth Empowerment and Innovation Center to be launched at the institution, developed in partnership with UNDP, the Kenya School of Government, the National Youth Council and the Frontier Counties Development Council. The planned facility includes a capacity building and computer lab unit, indoor and outdoor games facilities, and talent development in film making and acting in collaboration with the Kenya Film and Classification Board.

context.description: Homa Hills Vocational Training Centre is a public Vocational Training Centre registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0019/2022 on 27 July 2022, with a licence valid to 26 July 2027 and the status 'Registered and Licensed'. The centre is located at Kendu Bay on the C19 road in Homa Bay County, in the Rachuonyo area where it is reported to be the only vocational training centre serving the surrounding rural community near Lake Victoria. The regulator lists Trade Test-level courses examined by the National Industrial Training Authority in carpentry and joinery, tailoring, and dressmaking, and the centre also collaborates with NITA on industrial attachment placements. It operates as the implementing project of the Home Hills Community Organization, a community-based organization founded in 1980 that registered as an NGO in 1994 and initiated vocational training in tailoring, hairdressing, carpentry and metalwork. The Van Doorn Foundation and the Tools-To-Work Foundation supported the centre with a school business plan, curriculum development and a 2022 shipment of machines and tools, and the centre targets about 250 youths with marketable skills each year through two-year courses.

context.description: Homabay Vocational Training Centre (HVTC) is a public vocational training centre located at Homa Bay Youth Polytechnic on the Homa Bay – Kendubay Road in Homa Bay County. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered the centre on 12 April 2018 under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0100/2018, and its current register entry shows the status 'Registered and Licensed' with the licence running to 22 July 2030. The regulator's register lists thirteen accredited programme entries spanning electrical installation, fashion design and garment making, food and beverage, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, arc welding, carpentry and joinery, electrical wiremanship, plumbing and pipe fitting, tailoring and dressmaking, examined by KNEC and NITA. The centre's own website states that it offers practical, industry-relevant technical and vocational training to prepare learners for employment, entrepreneurship and further education, with departmental workshop-based training and an annual intake for which applications are open.

context.description: Homeboyz Institute of Technology (HIT) is a creative training hub at 7735 Muchai Drive, off Ngong Road in Nairobi, which describes itself as Africa's premier event and entertainment technology training institution. It specialises in proficiency-based education built around the precise skills and competencies demanded by the entertainment and audiovisual industry, delivered as professional courses, masterclasses, bootcamps and customised corporate training for businesses and parastatals. The current prospectus on its fee-structure page lists nine programmes across three tracks: Professional Courses (Music Production, DJ School, Live Sound Production, Lighting Design), Launchpad Programs (Foundation Certificate in Event Technology, Event Management and Planning, Video Display Systems & Live Event Screen Management) and the NextGen Academy (NextGen DJ Program and NextGen Music Bootcamp for learners aged 12-17). The curriculum is designed with input from industry experts and combines theoretical knowledge with extensive practical experience on industry-standard equipment in real-world production environments. Programme levels are the institute's own awards rather than KNEC, CDACC or NITA qualifications, so they are recorded at Certificate level with an internal examination body.

context.description: Hunter College of Health Sciences is a private medical training institution located in Runyenjes, Embu County, Kenya, registered by the TVETA under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0074/2025 and approved by the Nursing Council of Kenya (NCK) to offer nursing training. The college describes its mission as providing high-quality health sciences education that equips students with practical clinical skills, professional ethics and the competence required to improve healthcare delivery. Its flagship offering is the three-year Kenya Registered Community Health Nursing (KRCHN) diploma, open to KCSE C (Plain) holders with Biology C, English/Kiswahili C and Chemistry/Physics/Maths C-, supported by a one-year KRCHN bridging programme for students upgrading into the diploma. The TVETA accredited course table further lists a KNEC Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics, TVET CDACC Home Care Management at Level 4, and TVET CDACC Community Health and Health Records and Information Technology, both at Level 5, while the site also advertises a Health Services Support (Caregiver) programme at Levels 4 and 5. Students can study as day scholars or boarders, with intakes in January, May and September, an application fee of KES 1,000, and campus life covering clinical laboratories, sports, events and student accommodation near the campus.

context.description: ICS Technical College traces its origins to 2005, initially operating as a non-profit organization dedicated to HIV/AIDS Management and Community Empowerment. In 2008, it collaborated with the Ministry of Public Health and Sanitation to provide training for VCT counselors. Following a rebranding in 2012, the institution launched its School of Information Communication and Technology (ICT), quickly becoming a prominent ICT training provider in Nairobi and a designated digital village by the Ministry of ICT. By 2013, ICS College pioneered offering free tablets to students enrolled in courses lasting over six months. The institution has since expanded significantly, now encompassing 13 specialized schools across multiple branches, including the Mombasa branch established in May 2017. The college's mission is to deliver comprehensive, high-quality, relevant, transformative, and innovative education and training through teaching, research, and social development services to the community. It aims to inspire, prepare, and empower students for success in a dynamic global environment, equipping them with the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities for workforce entry or university progression.

context.description: Ikutha Technical and Vocational College appears on the TVETA register as a public technical and vocational college under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0002/2020, registered on 23 January 2020 and licensed to 16 May 2030 in the Registered and Licensed status, located at Ikutha in Kitui County, Eastern region. The regulator's course table lists six awards, all examined by KNEC: an artisan welding and fabrication course, an NVCET refrigeration and air conditioning technology course, craft awards in electrical and electronics technology (power), ICT and welding and fabrication, and a diploma in accountancy. The college's own website (ikuthatvc.ac.ke, fetched 2026-11-09) identifies it as a public TVET institution in Kitui South Constituency training young people since 2021, delivering 38 accredited programmes through CBET Levels 3-6, Recognition of Prior Learning and dual training, assessed by TVET CDACC, and names one centre of excellence in refrigeration and air conditioning plus five training departments. The site's contact block prints Ikutha Town, Kitui South sub-county, Kitui County along the Kitui-Kibwezi Highway; P.O. Box 4-90207, Ikutha; call or WhatsApp 0798002148; and email info@ikuthatvc.ac.ke, and reports about 670 trainees enrolled with 40 qualified trainers.

context.description: The TVET Authority register lists this institution as IMANI MARIANISTS MARIA TRAINING CENTER under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0009/2015, registered on 17 February 2015 with a licence valid to 27 February 2030 as a private Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County. The register records thirteen course rows in food and beverage, catering and accommodation operations, catering management, hairdressing, beauty therapy, tailoring and dressmaking, examined by KNEC and NITA, with duplicate rows collapsed here. The operating organisation brands itself IMANI Marianists, an acronym for Initiative from the Marianists to Assist the Needy to be Independent, and describes itself as a faith-based body under the Catholic Archdiocese of Nairobi offering vocational skills training since 1986. Its own site states that IMANI Marianists operates two training centres: Maria Training Center in Eastleigh, established in 1987, and Chaminade Training Centre in Mukuru kwa Njenga, both delivering six months of intensive hands-on training followed by a three-month industry attachment through its Job Creation Programme. Beyond seven nationally recognised full certificate programmes in hairdressing and beauty, food production and service, clothing technology, ICT and AI tools, machine knitting, electrical and solar installation, and metalwork, the centre runs more than 45 short courses across seven schools (cosmetology, hospitality and culinary arts, fashion and textile technology, technical studies, ICT and digital media, adult education, and health sciences) with four intakes a year in January, April, July and September. The Maria campus also houses an onsite Day Care Centre and a pre-school (Saragossa) that anchor its partnership with the surrounding community.

context.about: Impact Chefs & Hospitality Academy, presented on its website as Impact Hospitality and Tourism Institute, is a private culinary and hospitality training institution based in Nairobi. It offers diploma and certificate programmes in food production and culinary arts, pastry and bakery, food and beverage service, and food safety including HACCP, alongside short courses and hospitality consultancy.

context.description: Impact Chefs & Hospitality Academy delivers hands-on culinary and hospitality training from a campus in Nairobi equipped with lecture halls, a modern kitchen and ICT infrastructure for online learning. Its programme menu covers diploma and certificate routes in food production and culinary arts, diploma and certificate routes in pastry and bakery, a certificate in food and beverage, HACCP and food safety courses, food safety at levels 1 and 2, and basic cookery, alongside one to three month short courses. The academy states a vision to be a leading culinary and hospitality service provider in Africa, a mission to offer reliable, committed and efficient customer-based hospitality services, and core values of passion and excellence, and it also runs hospitality consultancy drawing on consultants with 15 to 20 years of hotel industry experience. It says its tutors are practising chefs from major hotel establishments, that at least 60 students a year receive financial assistance through work-study programmes, and that it is recognised by the Kenya Revenue Authority as a distinguished taxpayer under the college tax society. The website publishes a TVETA registration certificate and NITA certification as evidence of accreditation.

context.description: Imperial College of Medical and Health Sciences (ICMHS) is a private tertiary institution approved by TVETA, dedicated to providing transformative and relevant medical and health sciences education. With campuses in Thika and Nakuru, ICMHS aims to produce quality graduates who can serve Kenya and beyond. context.description: Inceptor Institute of Technology operates from Hazina Towers on Utalii Lane in Nairobi, on the 18th floor opposite Anniversary Towers, and publishes its postal address as PO Box 1169-00515, Nairobi. Its own pages state that the institute is registered and accredited by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA), and that applicable competency-based programmes are assessed under recognised TVET CDACC frameworks. The published catalogue lists 69 short professional courses across artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, software development, cloud computing, data analytics, Power BI, digital marketing and freelancing, most of them sold as multi-week online programmes delivered through the institute's own course platform and learner accounts. One programme is published with an explicit award level: the Music Art Technology Diploma at Level 6, a three-year programme whose assessment is internal continuous assessment plus external assessment by assessors appointed by TVET CDACC, with a national certificate of competency issued by TVET CDACC in conjunction with the institute. The institute publishes the telephone numbers +254 728 456 781 and +254 712 369 902 and the address admin@inceptor.co.ke, and states that it offers both online and physical learning options.

context.description: The Indian Ocean Maritime Training Centre is a privately owned training centre located on Kenya's North Coast at Watamu, offering maritime training for seafarers, boat operators, divers, boat mechanics, swimming pool attendants and beach lifeguards, and it also has capacity to provide maritime consultancy services. Its published course groups are RYA training, customised boat handling, outboard engine maintenance, STCW basic safety training, maritime safety training, diving, lifesaving and swimming, and electronics training, and it states that its emphasis on maritime training means many courses are adaptable to shore-based settings such as shopping centres, office buildings, factories, hotels and schools. The centre states a vision of providing professional training solutions anywhere within Eastern Africa using highly trained instructors at the highest ethical, environmental and professional global standards, and a mission of preparing trainees for the safety requirements of the professional world. It reports that its instructors are RYA, PBI or RYA Advanced PBI qualified, that outboard engine instructors are approved and trained by Yamaha, and that instruction is available in English, Kiswahili, French and German. Contact details published on the site are info@maritimetraining.co.ke with telephone numbers 0714 998805 and 0723 974666, located at Mida Creek Watamu.

context.description: The Institute of Advanced Technology (IAT) is a private ICT and business training institution established in August 1991 and incorporated as Institute of Advanced Technology Ltd, with its head campus on the first floor of Hazina Towers on Monrovia Street off Utalii Lane in Nairobi and additional campuses in Buruburu and Mombasa. It states that it is accredited by the TVET Authority under the Ministry of Education and registered with the National Industrial Training Authority, and that its systems follow ISO 9001:2015 guidelines. Teaching is organised into four strands: End-User Training covering ICDL, Advanced Excel, SPSS, STATA, Power BI, QuickBooks, AutoCAD, ArchiCAD, digital marketing and graphic design; Authorized Training in software engineering, programming, data science, CCNA, CCNP, ITIL and multiple CompTIA and Oracle tracks; Professional Programmes led by ACCA; and TVET-CDACC certificate and diploma programmes in Information Communication Technology and Cyber Security. The institute publishes a student portal, offers early-morning, Saturday-only and online classes for its branches, and describes itself as a Microsoft Partner, CompTIA and ICDL training centre serving government ministries, NGOs and private sector clients for over 34 years.

context.about: The Institute of Energy Studies and Research (IESR) is the energy-sector training, research and consultancy institute associated with Kenya Power, offering TVET-CDACC certificate and diploma training as well as professional courses in power systems, energy and leadership.
context.description: IESR describes itself as a centre of excellence for energy education, research, innovation and consultancy, and states that it has been shaping Africa's energy future since 1957. Its Academics section trains certificate and diploma students under the TVET-CDACC framework, while capacity building serves Kenya Power staff and corporate clients. The Utility Management and Consultancy section provides meter testing, calibration, energy-efficiency and utility-management services, and a Standards Development section promotes ISO quality compliance. The institute is registered and licensed by TVETA as a public Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0012/2016, registered on 2016-01-28 with licence expiry 2030-03-28 per the regulator's institution record. The institute's principal domain is iesr.ac.ke: it is live, carries the institute's own contact block (P.O. Box 30099-00100 Nairobi, iesrinfo@kplc.co.ke and +254 725559900) and is the address recorded as the identity website. The parallel KPLC Institute domain kplcinstitute.ac.ke serves the same institute and hosts the logo asset used here, but is not adopted as the principal domain. The regulator's programme table lists artisan, craft and diploma awards examined by KNEC and NITA, while the institute's Academics section advertises TVET-CDACC certificate and diploma training, so both are recorded; because several titles appear at both craft and diploma level, the award level is carried in each course label.

name: International College of Peace Studies

context.about: International College of Peace Studies is a private technical and vocational college listed by the TVET Authority in Nairobi County. Its registered awards cover counselling, social work and community development and business management, examined by KNEC and CDACC, preparing students for psychosocial support and community-development work. The college's own site publishes an 'Our Address' block giving Granti Road, Karen, Nairobi, Kenya together with the mailbox info@collegeofpeacestudies.com and the WhatsApp and call line +254 777 349 110.
context.description: International College of Peace Studies appears in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0037/2021, a Technical and Vocational College under private ownership in Nairobi County, registered on 26 April 2021. The register's status column reports an Expired License with an expiry date of 25 April 2026, while its separate expiry-date field still carries 5 October 2031; the conflicting register fields are recorded here and the status column is taken as authoritative, so registration_status is recorded as Expired. The course table lists three awards: KNEC Counselling and KNEC Social Work and Community Development, both at Diploma level, and a CDACC Level 6 award in Business Management recorded at the Diploma level under this batch's mapping convention. The college's own site, fetched live, describes an institution founded on the humanitarian principles of humanity, neutrality, impartiality and independence and states that it partners with the United Nations University for Peace and maintains offices in the United States, Germany and Kenya. Its 'Our Address' block publishes Granti Road, Karen, Nairobi, Kenya, together with info@collegeofpeacestudies.com and the line +254 777 349 110, so the college is recorded at Karen in Nairobi County, the county the regulator records. One secondary page of the same site prints an alternative footer address at Kunde Road, Kajiado; the address block on the homepage and the admissions page, and the registered county, are consistent with Karen in Nairobi, so the Kajiado variant is not adopted.

context.description: JOOUST is a public chartered university whose main campus sits in Bondo, Siaya County, in western Kenya, roughly 62 kilometres west of Kisumu. It was established on 11 May 2009 as Bondo University College, a constituent college of Maseno University, on land previously held by Bondo Teachers College, and received its own charter as an independent university in 2013. The university teaches bachelor's degrees across business and IT, education with IT, early childhood, special needs, tourism, logistics, biotechnology, agribusiness, actuarial science and library and knowledge management, delivered through its schools, institutes and a TVET Institute. Its contacts page publishes switchboard lines 057-2058000 and 057-2501804, the general mailboxes information@jooust.ac.ke and complaints@jooust.ac.ke and a vice-chancellor line at vc@jooust.ac.ke, with dedicated contacts for the Kisumu and Nambale campuses. The university runs a Centre for E-Learning whose Moodle platform is live at https://ejooust.ac.ke/ and linked as ELEARNING from the university home and contacts pages, and it held its 13th graduation ceremony on 17 December 2025 at which over 2,000 graduands received awards.

context.description: Jobplus Medical and Health Sciences Training College is a private health and technical college operating from two Nairobi campuses, on Jogoo Road opposite City Stadium and at Utawala. Its website advertises 72 accredited programmes across 15 departments covering health sciences, ICT, hospitality and culinary arts, early childhood and Montessori, engineering trades and business, and states that it serves about 1,500 learners each year. Teaching is organised on a competency-based model with programme lengths quoted in terms, from short three-month certificate and artisan courses up to nine-term diplomas such as Health Records and IT, Nutrition and Dietetics and Assistant Community Health Officer. The college highlights laboratory provision including theatre simulation, science and health-records laboratories at both campuses, clinical attachment at Nairobi hospitals included in every diploma, and recruitment routes to Germany, Canada and the Gulf for graduates. It also operates a daily-fee payment model through M-Pesa and a campus cafeteria, with rolling intakes on the fifth of each month after the opening intake, and awards are described as sitting with TVET CDACC, NITA and ICDL depending on the course.

description: Jodan College of Technology is a private TVET institution located at Jodan Towers on Kwame Nkrumah Street in Thika Town, Kiambu County, Kenya. The campus aims to train healthcare professionals to meet the growing demand for medical personnel in the region and beyond. As part of the larger Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) network, which has 92 campuses across the country, KMTC Isiolo contributes to KMTC's mission of providing accessible and quality middle-level medical training. The institution plays a role in supporting the government's agenda for Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and Kenya's Vision 2030. The campus has seen infrastructure development, including the unveiling of a modern hostel block courtesy of the county government, which aims to enhance student security and living conditions. Additionally, plans are in place to develop an adjacent emergency center at Isiolo Referral Hospital, which is expected to provide attachment and employment opportunities for students.

The college's own website lists Iten among its campuses and hosts the campus directory, and it publishes 126 medical courses across seven faculties and eighteen departments, spanning certificate, diploma, higher diploma and short-course provision. Campus-level allocation of individual programmes is not published in the public academic programmes listing, so this record lists only the college-level certificate and diploma health programmes that define KMTC provision without asserting which of them are currently mounted at Iten. The college operates a shared e-learning platform at elearning.kmtc.ac.ke, an admissions portal at admissions.kmtc.ac.ke and a student portal at portal.kmtc.ac.ke, all linked from the kmtc.ac.ke homepage. KMTC is headquartered off Ngong Road in Nairobi, while Iten Campus sits in Elgeyo Marakwet County.

name: KMTC Kapenguria Campus

context.about: KMTC Kapenguria Campus is a Kenya Medical Training College campus in Kapenguria, West Pokot County, training nurses, clinical medicine officers, nutritionists and community health practitioners in partnership with the county government.
context.description: KMTC Kapenguria Campus is a constituent campus of the Kenya Medical Training College, listed as campus number 20 in the college's published campus contacts register with the address P.O. Box 576-30600 Kapenguria, the email kapenguria@kmtc.ac.ke and the telephone line 0207855985. A Ministry of Health news report published on 2023-11-14 states that the campus was established in September 2014 and has since grown from offering a Diploma in Nursing to a wider range of courses including certificates in Nutrition and Community Health Nursing and a Diploma in Clinical Medicine. The same report notes that the campus is supported by the County Government of West Pokot, is among the top-performing campuses of the 74 KMTC colleges nationwide, and is served by Kapenguria County Referral Hospital, with plans for a Higher Diploma in Nephrology. The four awards recorded here are those named explicitly in that ministry report; the report does not name an external examining body, so these college-examined awards carry the literal exam body 'internal'. The college operates a shared e-learning portal at https://elearning.kmtc.ac.ke on which its programme units are published.
