context.description: Established in 1985 as a polytechnic and upgraded to a technical training institute in 2011, Mukiria Technical Training Institute (MTTI) is a public TVET institution located in Meru County, Kenya. Its mission is to nurture and impart knowledge, skills, and professional attitudes through research, innovation, and technology, fostering self-reliance and driving national development, encapsulated in its motto: "Excellence in Skills and Competence." The institute aims to produce skilled, globally competitive, employable, and self-reliant human resources by offering market-driven courses that address labor market gaps. MTTI is committed to expanding its capacity in business and technical courses, emphasizing work competence, entrepreneurial initiative, and integrated ICT skills. The institute is governed by a Board of Management and is accredited by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA) and the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC).

conflict.proposed_value: Murang'a University of Technology is a public chartered university established under the Universities Act, 2012, and listed by the Commission for University Education among Kenya's public chartered universities with an accreditation year of 2016. Its main campus sits in Murang'a town, Murang'a County (P.O. Box 75-10200, Murang'a), with a second campus at Mariira, and the university states on its website that it is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified. The regulator's institution record, captured on 5 December 2025, showed the status as 'Registered and Licensed' at that licence expiry date, while the regulator's accredited-institutions listing currently records the licence as expired on 20 July 2026; because tveta.go.ke is presently serving substituted content, that status is kept as an open conflict to re-confirm when the domain is restored, and it was not treated as a renewed licence valid to 2031. The institute's own page on the Murang'a University of Technology website states that it was registered on 21 July 2021 as a Technical and Vocational College under Section 20(1) of the TVET Act 2013 and is domiciled within the university, consistent with the regulator's record. The university's Deans and Directors page lists Dr. Elly Tetty Osewe, Ph.D., as Ag. Director, TVET, while the institute page describes him as Director of the MUT-TVET Institute. The institute advertises 36 diploma programmes and 6 certificate programmes spread over nine academic departments. The regulator's programme table publishes fifteen accreditation rows which collapse to fourteen distinct qualifications, all examined by TVET CDACC at Levels 5 and 6 and mapped here to diploma and higher diploma; the CDACC level is carried in each course label because information communication technology is registered at both levels.

context.description: Mwala Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college situated approximately 250 meters off the Makutano/Kithimani road in Mwala Subcounty, about 36.9 km east of Machakos Town and 102.9 km from Nairobi. The college was registered by TVETA on 21 July 2021 under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0048/2021 and holds a licence running to 31 July 2031 with status Registered and Licensed. Under Chief Principal Kavita C. Kyuli, its inaugural principal since September 2020, the college has grown to host over 3,000 trainees across academic departments covering automotive and mechanical engineering, electrical and electronic engineering, building and civil engineering, agriculture and applied sciences, fashion design and cosmetology, hospitality and institutional management, and business studies and ICT. Training runs from Artisan (Level 4) through Certificate (Level 5) to Diploma (Level 6), with programmes examined by KNEC, NITA and TVET CDACC. Prospective trainees can join through KUCCPS government sponsorship or as self-sponsored students, with HELB loans available for the January, May and September intakes.

context.description: Mwambiti Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Taita Taveta County, in Kenya's Coast region, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0052/2016. The TVETA register records a registration date of 14 April 2016 and a licence expiry of 8 October 2028, with the institution listed as registered and licensed. The regulator's programme table lists a KNEC craft programme in electrical and electronics technology (power) and NITA trade-test courses in carpentry and joinery, electrical wireman, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, tailoring and dressmaking. A 2026-11-09 fetch of the teacher.co.ke listing (https://teacher.co.ke/amp/mwambiti-vocational-training-center-courses-contacts-fees-and-registration-details/) - vetted on exact name and matching registration TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0052/2016 - corroborates the same programme mix, places the centre 'near Voi Town' in Taita Taveta County and publishes postal address P.O. Box 478-80300 Voi; the postal address is recorded here in narrative, and no phone or email is published on that page. A 2026-11-09 fetch of TVETA's magazine The TVET Eye issue 004 (https://www.tveta.go.ke/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/THE-TVETA-EYE-2023-issue-4-final.pdf) again lists 'Mwambiti Vocational Training Center' among institutions registered as of end October 2023, a second fetched regulator source, and an active May-2025 enrolment post on a Taita Taveta community Facebook group surfaced in search but was login-walled and not fetched. Because the listing only says 'near Voi Town', the town and location stay 'unknown' rather than estimated.

context.description: The TVETA register consulted on 24 October 2026 records Mwembeni Technical Training Institute under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0036/2022, registered on 20 April 2022 and licensed to 19 April 2027, with registration status 'Registered and Licensed', classified as a private TVC in Kilifi County. The institute's Facebook post of 10 February 2026 also advertsises free tailoring training at Majengo Kanamai-Mtwapa. No official institutional website or verified official social page beyond the Facebook post could be fetched during this research, so email and telephone remain unrecorded rather than estimated.

about: Nairobi Institute of Business Studies (NIBS), now trading as NIBS Technical College, is a private TVET institution headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, offering industry-relevant certificate and diploma programmes to more than 5,000 students across 39 programmes. It is registered by TVETA and delivers competency-based training in business, ICT, automotive, hospitality and health-related fields.
description: Nairobi Institute of Business Studies, which now operates as NIBS Technical College, is a private technical and vocational college with its campuses in Nairobi and Kiambu. The college website describes it as offering industry-relevant certificate and diploma programmes designed to equip students with practical skills for the modern workforce, and it reports more than 5,000 students, 39 programmes and a 95 per cent job placement rate. Its published programme portfolio includes CDACC Level 6 programmes in computer science and automotive engineering, ICM diploma programmes in journalism and media studies, cosmetology and international hospitality management, and a certificate-level caregiver course. The college states that its programmes are fully accredited by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority, and the regulator's register carries the Nairobi CBD campus under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0151/2025, registered on 29 July 2025 with a licence valid to 28 July 2030. The college describes its training as competency-based, supported by industry partnerships for internships and job placement.

context.description: Nairobi Institute of Technology is a privately owned and managed mid-level college established in 1997 and located at 10 Westlands Road in Westlands, Nairobi, registered and licensed by TVETA as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0047/2015 with a licence current to 6 December 2026. It teaches architecture and the built environment, ICT, animation and digital media, engineering, business and accountancy, health records and medical laboratory technology at certificate, diploma and degree level, and operates a three-semester system with intakes in January, May and September. Programmes are delivered in partnership with Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology for the JKUAT diploma and certificate awards, with KASNEB for the accountancy and credit qualifications, and with TVET CDACC for competency-based awards such as the Level 6 Diploma in Animation and Digital Media. The college publishes its address as 10 Westlands Road, Westlands, the inboxes info@nit.ac.ke and admissions@nit.ac.ke, telephone and WhatsApp lines on +254 746 462326 and +254 703 825614, an online application portal at https://admissions.nit.ac.ke/ and a Facebook page at facebook.com/NairobiInstituteofTechnology. The imported record carried a student count of 300 and a claim of a learning-management-system portal, neither of which is published on the pages examined, so the count is null and e-learning is recorded as none.

context.description: Nairobi Pentecostal Bible College is a privately owned theological college recorded in the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register of accredited institutions as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0048/2019, in Nairobi County, with a licence valid to 24 September 2029 and a status of Registered and Licensed. The regulator's course table lists five accredited awards, all examined by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council under the competency-based curriculum, covering Christian chaplaincy, Christian ministry and counselling psychology. Level 5 awards are recorded in Christian chaplaincy and counselling psychology, and level 6 awards in Christian chaplaincy, Christian ministry and counselling psychology. context.description: Nakuru International College is a private technical and vocational college in Nakuru County, in Kenya's Rift Valley, recorded in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0079/2024 with a licence valid to 14 May 2029 and the status 'Registered and Licensed'. The register lists fourteen accredited qualifications spanning business, health, engineering and hospitality. Seven are diploma programmes examined by KNEC in business administration, business management, food and beverage production sales and service management, social work and community development, human resource management and secretarial studies, plus an information communication technology diploma examined by KASNEB. Six competency-based courses are assessed by TVET CDACC, five at level 5 certificate level in automotive engineering, electrical engineering, fashion design technology, health records and information technology, and healthcare support services, together with level 6 diploma courses in community health and cosmetology. No institutional website, email address or telephone line appears in the regulator's entry, so those identity fields remain unset.

context.description: Nashulai Cultural Training Centre is a training institution operated as a project of the Nashulai Maasai Conservancy, which borders the Maasai Mara game reserve in Narok County. It is registered with TVETA as a private Technical and Vocational College (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0090/2025, Registered and Licensed, Narok County) and states it was established in 2019 to give local young people tourism and hospitality skills suited to the Maasai Mara tourism economy. It opened with ten students in tourism and hospitality and later added environmental conservation, indigenous knowledge and computer studies, and reports a current enrolment of about 110 students drawn from the greater Narok area and other parts of Kenya. context.description: Ndere Vocational Training Center was registered by the TVET Authority on 3 June 2016 under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0144/2016, and the register snapshot of 25 October 2026 records the licence as Registered and Licensed with an expiry date of 18 June 2029. The TVETA course table lists nineteen rows with no exact duplicates, comprising two KNEC NVCET programmes (Agri-Business and Information Communication Technology), ten NITA trade tests (Carpentry and Joinery, Electrical Wireman, Hairdressing, Masonry, Motor Vehicle Mechanics, Plumbing and Pipe fitting, Tailoring, Welding and Fabrication, Dressmaking and Beauty Therapy) and seven CDACC competency-based courses at Levels 3 and 4 (Electrical Installation, Masonry, Agriculture Extension, Building Artisan (Masonry), Fashion Design Technology and Information Communication Technology). Under the level-normalisation convention used across this dataset, NVCET, NITA Trade Test and CDACC Levels 3 and 4 are all recorded at Artisan level, because none of these awards is a craft certificate or diploma. As a county vocational training centre the institution is publicly owned and registered in the VTC category. The register publishes no postal address, town, e-mail address, telephone number, website or staff list, so those fields remain null rather than guessed.

Its published programme list covers a Certificate IV in Plant Operation with heavy machinery operation and safety training, ICT pathways in full stack development, cybersecurity, data science and machine learning delivered with Cisco Networking Academy, CompTIA and Microsoft Learn certification, hairdressing and beauty therapy, sound engineering and music production, and a driving school; only the plant operation certificate and the NITA-accredited hairdressing award carry a programme level that can be mapped to the Schologic enumeration, so the remaining professional and vendor short courses are described here rather than listed. The institute publishes the contact address Migori, Kenya, the telephone number +254 713 584 858 and the email addresses info@niteducation.com and newtoninstituteoftechnology@gmail.com. No student population figure is published, and the site hosts no learning-management or distance-learning portal.

context.about: Ngenyilel Vocational Training Center, formerly Kapkoi Village Polytechnic, is a public vocational training centre in Kapkoi Village, Ngenyilel Ward, Turbo Sub-County, Uasin Gishu County, Kenya. It was started in 2012 by local leaders and the community with assistance from the CDF Eldoret North office and is registered and licensed by TVETA as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0221/2019. Its motto is 'Skills are wings of education' and its mission is to provide quality and innovative technical skills to the youth for the benefit of self and society at large.

context.description: Ngenyilel Vocational Training Centre, formerly Kapkoi Village Polytechnic, was started in 2012 by local leaders and the community with assistance from the CDF Eldoret North office, which funded the classrooms and administration block while community members purchased the land. The County Government of Uasin Gishu supported completion of classrooms and a workshop in 2014 and 2015 and provided tools and equipment in 2017 and early 2018, and the centre now operates under the county's Department of Education, Youth, Gender, Culture, Sports and Social Services following the 2014 rebranding of Youth Polytechnics into Vocational Training Centres. The centre is located in Uasin Gishu County, Turbo Sub-County, Ngenyilel Ward, Ngenyilel location and Kapkoi village, physically near Kipkaren River shopping centre off the Eldoret-Bungoma road, approximately 6 km from the Kipkaren centre. TVETA registered it on 10 July 2019 as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0221/2019, and it is shown as 'Registered and Licensed' on the 24 October 2026 register snapshot with the licence running to 21 January 2031. Its official website publishes two-year KNEC/NITA trade courses in Masonry, Electrical Installation, Food & Beverage, Plumbing, Garment Making, Motor Vehicle Mechanics and Hair Dressing at a tuition of KES 9,000 per year, plus a two-month internal Computer Packages course, alongside the four NITA trade-test programmes on the TVETA register. The website lists Masonry as a County Centre of Excellence receiving an annual national grant.

context.description: Njoro Technical Training Institute is a public TVET institution in Njoro, Nakuru County, registered by TVETA as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0001/2023 on 26 January 2023 with a licence valid to 25 January 2028. It opened to the public for training in January 2023 and is officially registered with KUCCPS for centralized student placement. The institute positions itself as a Centre of Excellence in Automotive Engineering and delivers Competency-Based Education and Training (CBET) programmes from Level 3 to Level 6, examined by TVET CDACC, alongside KNEC craft and diploma programmes and NITA trade tests. Its own-site course matrix lists CBET diplomas in ICT, Computer Science Technology, Building Technology, Civil Engineering Mechanics, Electrical Engineering (Power Option), Automotive Technology Infrastructure, and Welding and Structural Fabrication, plus certificates and artisan courses in plumbing and electrical artisanship. The institution is headed by Principal Mrs. Tabitha Githaiga and reports over 1,500 active enrollments across its specialised departments.

about: North Horr Technical Training Institute is a public technical and vocational college in Marsabit County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0027/2019. It offers artisan, craft and diploma programmes examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council in electrical installation, plumbing, welding and fabrication, building technology, business management, information communication technology, secretarial studies and social work.
description: North Horr Technical Training Institute appears in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as a public technical and vocational college in Marsabit County, registered on 7 June 2019 under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0027/2019 with a licence valid to 20 January 2030 in 'Registered and Licensed' status. The regulator's institution record lists nine accredited awards spanning three qualification levels: artisan electrical installation, plumbing and welding and fabrication; craft certificates in building technology, business management, information communication technology and secretarial studies; and diplomas in information communication technology and social work and community development. Every award is examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council rather than by the TVET CDACC, so the college's recorded accredited provision sits fully on the KNEC technical and business curriculum. That spread across construction, electrical, business and social-development disciplines indicates a general-purpose public college serving the pastoralist economy of northern Marsabit County, close to the Ethiopian border. No institutional website, e-mail address, telephone line or street-level address is published in the sources fetched this run, so those identity fields are recorded as null or unknown; the town is recorded only as the locality named in the institution's own title.

context.description: Nyahururu Medical Training College is a private health-training college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 12 April 2018 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0041/2018, with a licence running to 8 October 2028 and the status 'Registered and Licensed'. The college is located in Ziwani Estate along the Nyahururu-Nyeri Road at the boundary of Laikipia and Nyandarua Counties, and started operations in February 2016 as a centre for continuing professional development for medical and allied health professionals. Its TVETA-accredited programmes are competency-based health qualifications assessed by TVET CDACC from Level 4 to Level 6, spanning community health, caregiving, health records and information technology, healthcare support services, orthopaedic and trauma medicine and perioperative theatre technology. The college website additionally offers Kenya Registered Community Health Nursing accredited by the Nursing Council of Kenya, Clinical Medicine and Surgery under the Clinical Officers Council, and further programmes such as counselling psychology, nutrition and dietetics, medical laboratory and ICT. The college states it is fully accredited by TVETA, NCK, COC, AMRO-K, KNDI and TVET CDACC, and operates modern laboratories and a simulation ward opened in August 2025.

context.about: Nyakach Technical and Vocational College is a public TVC in Kisumu County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the TVETA as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0009/2019 offering artisan, certificate and diploma programmes examined by KNEC, NITA and TVET CDACC.
context.description: Nyakach Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college in Kisumu County, Nyanza, recorded in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0009/2019 with a licence valid to 27 February 2030 and the status 'Registered and Licensed'. Its accredited programmes are delivered at three levels and assessed by three different bodies. KNEC examines the artisan electrical installation course, craft and diploma programmes in building technology, electrical and electronics, information communication technology and mechanical engineering, while NITA assesses the welding and fabrication trade test. TVET CDACC provides the largest share of the portfolio, with level 3 and level 4 artisan courses in masonry, plumbing, culinary arts and food production, a level 5 certificate course in mechanical production technology, and level 5 and level 6 diploma courses in automotive engineering, electrical engineering, culinary arts and supply chain management. No institutional website, email address or telephone line is published in the regulator's entry for the college, so those identity fields remain unset rather than estimated.

location: Bogeka, Kisii-Oyugis Road off Marani Junction (P.O. Box 53-40200 Kisii)

context.about: Nyaore Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre on the Kisii-Oyugis Road at Bogeka, off Marani Junction in Kisii County, registered by TVETA under TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0014/2019. It delivers KNEC-examined NVCET certificate programmes and TVET CDACC competency courses in trades such as agri-business, building, electrical, ICT and garment making.
context.description: Nyaore Vocational Training Center is a public Vocational Training Centre (VTC) registered with the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 14 January 2019 under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0014/2019, recorded on the register as Registered and Licensed with a licence running to 22 September 2030. The centre is located at Bogeka on the Kisii-Oyugis Road off Marani Junction in Bogeka ward, Marani, Kisii County, with a postal address of P.O. Box 53-40200 Kisii (Plot No. WEST KITUTU/BOGETA/1325). The TVETA register publishes twelve programme entries for the centre: ten KNEC-examined NVCET certificate programmes covering agri-business, appropriate carpentry and joinery, building technology, electrical and electronics technology, fashion design and garment making, food processing technology, hairdressing and beauty therapy, information communication technology, metal processing technology and tannery and leatherwork technology, plus TVET CDACC Electrical Installation courses at Level 3 and Level 4. On Facebook the centre describes its mission as empowering youth with appropriate, adequate skills, knowledge and attitudes to realise their full potential for individual and national development, and the page counts about 2,669 followers. No institutional website, learning platform or published enrolment figure was found for the centre as of November 2026.

context.about: NYS Advanced Building School is a public technical and vocational college registered by the TVET Authority at Gilgil in Nakuru County, Kenya. It is accredited for KNEC craft and NVCET awards in building, electrical and carpentry trades, and CDACC competency based qualifications in construction and leather technology.
context.description: NYS Advanced Building School is recorded on the TVET Authority register as a public technical and vocational college under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0003/2017, with a registration date of 12 April 2017, a licence expiring 14 May 2029 and a status of Registered and Licensed. It is listed in Nakuru County, and a vetted education listing carrying the school's exact name and registration number places it at NYS College, Gilgil, off the Old Nairobi-Nakuru Road, with postal address P.O. Box 3-20116 Gilgil, telephone 0722 848 671 and email nysadvancedbuildingschool@yahoo.com, which are recorded here. Its accredited course list is concentrated in construction trades, covering KNEC craft and NVCET awards in building technology, carpentry and joinery, masonry, electrical installation and electrical and electronics technology, together with CDACC competency based qualifications in building, plumbing, welding and leather technology. The website value carried on the record, mutomohospital.or.ke, was fetched and belongs to Our Lady of Lourdes Mutomo Hospital, a mission hospital and health-sciences college in Kitui County, and is therefore not attributed to this school; no institutional website is claimed. No e-learning portal or distance-learning provision is published for this school.

context.about: NYS Institute of Business Studies is a public Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County, Kenya, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0016/2023 with a licence running to 30 July 2028. Its accredited table covers business, secretarial, accountancy, ICT, project-management and supply-chain awards from certificate to diploma level, examined by KNEC, KASNEB and the TVET CDACC.
context.description: NYS Institute of Business Studies is a public TVET institution recorded in the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register of accredited institutions as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0016/2023, registered on 31 July 2023 with a licence valid to 30 July 2028 and a status of Registered and Licensed, in Nairobi County. The register lists KNEC craft awards in business management, secretarial studies and supply chain management, and KNEC diploma awards in business management, human resource management, information communication technology, project management, sales and marketing, secretarial studies and supply chain management. Accountancy provision is examined by the Kenya Accountants and Secretaries National Examinations Board, with the Accounting Technicians Diploma at diploma level and Accounting and Management Skills at craft level; the board's professional-level Certified Public Accountants and Certified Secretaries qualifications also appear on the register but fall outside the schema's qualification levels and are therefore described here rather than recorded as courses. Competency-based training is delivered under the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council, with level 5 awards in business management, human resource management, office administration, store keeping and supply chain management and level 6 awards in business management, human resource management, information communication technology, office administration, project management and supply chain management. Register levels were normalised to the schema vocabulary, with Craft rendered as Certificate, CDACC level 5 as Certificate and CDACC level 6 as Diploma; the register publishes no street address, telephone line or institutional email for the institute, and no institution-owned website was confirmed in this pass, so those fields are recorded as absent rather than estimated.

context.description: Nzoia College of Nursing was founded in September 2010 by the late John Richard Wooley Robinson and Sr. Freda Nyanga Robinson and operates from a 25-acre campus along the Kitale-Webuye road near Birunda Market in Kiminini, Trans Nzoia County. The college states that it is approved by the Nursing Council of Kenya and describes a faith-based campus serving students and the wider community, with a board of management providing strategic leadership under a Strategic Plan 2023-2027. Its mission is to offer quality nursing education that promotes responsibility, creativity and accountability in every graduate, with a vision of being a centre of excellence in the training of nursing professionals in the region and beyond. Published programmes cover community health nursing at diploma level together with general nursing, midwifery, clinical placement training and skills laboratory simulation. Admission requires Kenyan citizenship, age 17 and above, a KCSE mean grade of C plain with C plain in English or Kiswahili and in Biology or Biological Sciences and C- in Physical Science, Physics, Chemistry or Mathematics, with intakes in March and September, and the published fee structure is Ksh 185,000 per year plus registration and NCK indexing charges.

context.description: Ochii Vocational Training Centre is a public vocational training centre in Baringo County recorded in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0052/2021. The register records a registration date of 26 April 2021 and a licence expiry date of 25 April 2026 with the status Expired License, so the centre's TVETA accreditation is not current as at this research pass. The centre sits on the Tenges – Ochii Road and was set up to offer skills training to young people, aiming to equip graduates with technical skills that match labour-market demand and support their livelihoods. Programmes are delivered at artisan level and include mechanical fitting and welding, dress making and fashion design, masonry, and welding and fabrication, examined by KNEC and NITA. The surviving course entries used the NITA trade-test label, which was normalised to the schema's Artisan level. The register publishes no street address, postal address or institutional website for the centre, and no named administrator or student population could be confirmed from an authoritative source.

context.description: Ofafa Vocational Training Center appears in the TVET Authority register as a public Vocational Training Centre in Nairobi County under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0005/2025. No institutional website is published by the regulator; the county portal and the centre's Facebook page are its web presence.

context.about: Omuga Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA) in Homa Bay County, Kenya. It offers artisan, craft and diploma programmes spanning agriculture, electrical and electronics technology, building, business, human resource, supply chain and social development disciplines. The college publishes on its own website that it is located 2.3 km off Misambi Market along the Kisumu-Oyugis-Kisii Highway in Kabondo Kasipul Constituency, and that it is a TVETA-registered and KNEC examination centre.
context.description: Omuga Technical and Vocational College appears on the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as a public TVC under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0002/2019. The register records a registration date of 2019-01-14 and a licence expiry of 2029-07-23, with the status shown as Registered and Licensed. Its registered county is Homabay, recorded here in canonical form as Homa Bay County within the Nyanza region. The TVETA course table lists sixteen award rows across agriculture, engineering, business and social development, all examined by KNEC and all distinct once identical name-and-level pairs are collapsed. Level normalisation follows the batch convention: Artisan rows remain Artisan, Craft rows are recorded as Certificate, and Diploma rows as Diploma, and the three programme names that appear at two qualification levels carry a level qualifier so each award stays distinct. context.description: Orthodox College of Africa is a private technical and vocational college in Nairobi County registered and licensed by the TVET Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0021/2023. courses.name: Diploma in Kenya Registered Community Health Nursing

context.description: Ortum Mission Hospital School of Nursing is recorded in the TVETA register as a private Technical and Vocational College in West Pokot County under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0019/2021, registered on 28 January 2021 with a licence valid to 16 February 2031 and the status Registered and Licensed. The regulator's course table shows no accredited courses for the institution at this date, so the programme profile here is drawn from the college's own website, which states that it offers a three-year Diploma in Kenya Registered Community Health Nursing approved by the Nursing Council of Kenya, delivered through general nursing, midwifery and community health departments. The college describes itself as a faith-based medical training institution in the Cherangani hills about 100 kilometres from Kitale along the Kitale-Lodwar highway, started in 1969 by Missionary Sisters of the Holy Rosary and owned by the Catholic Diocese of Kitale, currently managed by the Assumption Sisters of Eldoret. It publishes the postal address P.O. Box 15 - 30602 Ortum, the telephone line +254 792 879 345 and the email address ortumnursingsch010@yahoo.com, all recorded here from the fetched contact page. Admissions are stated to run in March and September each year against Nursing Council of Kenya entry criteria, and the site reports roughly 170 current students and 32 staff, which is recorded as the estimated student count; no named officer is published, so the personal contacts list is empty.

context.description: Our Lady of Mercy College - Chepareria is a private technical and vocational college at Chepareria market on the Kitale-Lodwar highway in West Pokot County, north of Kitale in Kenya's Rift Valley, near the Ugandan border. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0091/2018, registered on 18 July 2018 with a licence valid to 27 November 2028. The college is a ministry of the Congregation of the Sisters of Mercy, whose community was set up at Chepareria in the early 1980s with education as the focus of its ministry; two Sisters currently serve in the vocational training and artisan centres and another teaches in the local secondary school. The vocational training centre caters for young women, some of whom only attended primary school and others who escaped arranged early marriages, teaching skills for life particularly in tailoring and domestic science so that students may earn an independent living. Networking with other schools in the area enables the Centre to generate income from the production of uniforms, and many leavers set up their own small businesses in nearby towns.

context.description: Outspan Medical College (OMC) was a private health-sciences college on the outskirts of Nyeri Town, established as an extension of the Outspan Hospital to provide hospital-based clinical training. Its web presence has transitioned to Outspan Global University (OGU), which held its first graduation ceremony on 7 August 2026, and the TVETA register now lists the TVET institute as OUTSPAN GLOBAL UNIVERSITY TVET INSTITUTE, a private TVC in Nyeri County registered in 2016 and licensed to 2031. The institution offers KNEC- and TVET CDACC-examined certificate, diploma and higher-diploma programmes in areas such as medical laboratory technology, nutrition and dietetics, counselling psychology, pharmaceutical technology, information communication technology and perioperative theatre technology, alongside professional programmes in clinical medicine, community health nursing and medical laboratory sciences. Under OGU it has introduced degree programmes - BSc in Nursing, BSc in Clinical Medicine & Community Health and a Bachelor of Arts in Counselling Psychology - with applications handled through its online admission portal. Training is anchored on its affiliate Outspan Teaching & Referral Hospital, a Level 5 facility with branches in Nyeri, Embu and Nanyuki that hosts the OGU Annex with lecture halls, a library and a resource centre, and on the Outspan Serenity Center used for psychology placements.

context.description: Palazzolo Technical and Vocational Training Institute is a private TVETA-registered technical and vocational college located off Kihara-Gachie-Karura road in Kiambu County, on the Nairobi outskirts. The institute is registered with TVETA under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0045/2022, having been registered on 2022-07-27 with its licence running to 2027-07-26. Run under the mission charism of the Poverelle Sisters, it focuses on serving underprivileged youth with affordable, high-quality vocational education. name: Pioneer Sign Language Training Institute

context.about: Pioneer Sign Language Training Institute, which presents itself as Pioneer Institute of Sign Language, is a private institution in Mombasa dedicated to promoting the acquisition and interpretation of Kenyan Sign Language. It trains individuals and organisations and offers customised programmes to bridge the communication gap between Deaf and hearing communities in Kenya and beyond.
context.description: Pioneer Institute of Sign Language is an educational institution dedicated to promoting the acquisition and interpretation of Kenyan Sign Language, established with the mission of empowering individuals through high-quality KSL training and thereby bridging the communication gap between the Deaf and hearing communities in Kenya and beyond. It is located in the heart of Mombasa, where it describes having created a hub of learning in which students immerse themselves in the language and culture of the Deaf community. Its published services are Kenyan Sign Language acquisition training, Kenyan Sign Language interpreting training, and customised training programmes designed for individuals and organisations seeking to improve their proficiency in Kenyan Sign Language. The institute also advertises sign language training for both individuals and corporate clients, and presents a team of trainers described as competent and hands-on in training and promoting sign language. No award-level prospectus or examination body is published on the site, so the two named training programmes are recorded as internally examined certificate-level courses rather than being attributed to a national awarding body.

context.description: ProCare Centre is a privately owned healthcare training college operating from Afya Centre on Tom Mboya Street in Nairobi, registered and licensed by TVETA as a private vocational training centre under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0011/2024. All programmes are delivered full-time or part-time, in physical and online classes, with entry requirements ranging from KCSE D- to C- depending on the programme. The centre positions its graduates for employment in Kenyan hospitals and care facilities as well as international markets such as the UK, Canada, USA, Australia and Germany.

Profia Institute of Professionals is a private TVET-accredited college registered with TVETA (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0084/2021) and based in Homa Bay town, where it operates from Site Estate. The institute organises teaching through five schools: business, ICT, hospitality, engineering, and beauty and cosmetology. Its published catalogue names programmes including a Certificate in ICT, a Diploma in ICT and a Diploma in Data Management and Analytics, with the data management diploma requiring KCSE grade C- or a KASNEB technician or diploma certificate for entry. The website describes the institute as an approved KASNEB examination centre in Homa Bay offering TVET and KASNEB courses. Beyond the formal programmes, it advertises short professional courses such as Plumbing, Beauty Therapy, Barbering, Nail Technology and Housekeeping, and maintains an online-courses page and a holiday computer training programme.

context.description: Prudent College of Media (PCM) is a private institution established in 2021 under the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Act of 2013 and registered by TVETA as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0048/2021 in Uasin Gishu County, with the current register recording its licence as expired. It operates from Simphi House, 2nd floor, Oloo Street, in the Eldoret CBD, and describes itself as one of the leading colleges in the North Rift region offering ready-market oriented courses. Teaching is media-focused: a diploma and certificate in journalism and mass communication (with the diploma and single-subject diploma tracks examined by ICM), single-subject diplomas in broadcast journalism, media law and ethics, public relations and newspaper reporting, and a wide range of internal short courses covering video shooting and editing, TV and film production, drone flying, graphic design, photojournalism, deejaying, music and radio production, computer packages and language skills for journalists. Entry to certificate and short courses runs from KCSE certificate to D plain, while diploma tracks require C- at KCSE or a credit in a certificate course, with intakes open year-round. The college's stated vision is to create professional journalists through innovative training, and its director urges community youth to take the hands-on technical courses it offers.

context.description: Pumwani Maternity College of Nursing and Midwifery is a public nursing and midwifery college on General Waruingi Road in Nairobi, Kenya, registered by TVETA as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0003/2020 with a licence valid to 19 November 2030 and the status Registered and Licensed. The college traces its origin to 1927, when the Lady Grigg Welfare League founded it to supply midwives for the Lady Grigg African Hospital, and it was taken over by the Municipality of Nairobi in 1944; it is now run by a board of management with staff employed by the Nairobi City County Government. Its current advertised intake, published in its own updated brochure, covers a Higher National Diploma in Registered Midwifery, the Basic Diploma in Registered Community Health Nursing, Caregiver and Health Care Support courses, Perioperative Theatre Technology at certificate and diploma level, Community Health at diploma and certificate level, and a Certificate in Computer Technician. Although the college's TVETA record is current, the regulator's course table for this institution returns no accredited programmes, so the programme list is taken from the college's own brochure and the Nursing Council of Kenya is recorded as the examining and licensing body only for the nursing and midwifery awards. Contacts are the general line 0714 205 938 or 0758 624 818 and the address info@pumwanicollege.ac.ke.

The directorate operates under its parent, Pwani University, a public university situated in the scenic resort town of Kilifi in Kilifi County, about 60 km north of Mombasa and adjacent to the Indian Ocean; the university site lists P.O. Box 195-80108 Kilifi, phone +254 725 916 145 and info@pu.ac.ke. Directory listings place the directorate along Mombasa-Malindi Road in Kilifi with postal address P.O. Box 195-80108 and telephone 0725 986248, while Google Maps lists it in Lower Railway Railway Ward, Kilifi with the line +254 704 619848 and the university-domain contact email t.thoruwa@pu.ac.ke. KUCCPS records the institution as PWANI UNIVERSITY TVET COLLEGE, a public college under the University TVET parent ministry in Kilifi County, with no programmes declared for the 2026/2027 placement cycle.

The TVETA course table for the institute lists two awards, both in Information Communication Technology and both examined by KNEC: one at Craft level and one at Diploma level. The institute maintains its own website at qubit.institute, whose Contacts page gives a Machakos Town address at Emmanuel House, 2nd Floor, on the ACK Church grounds, together with the telephone (+254) 740 303 997 and the mailbox info@qubit.institute.

context.about: Ram Training College is a private technical and vocational college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0041/2017 and located in Kisii County, Kenya. It is accredited to offer KNEC craft and diploma programmes in social development, nutrition and dietetics and social work, together with TVET CDACC Level 5 and Level 6 programmes in community health and perioperative theatre technology. The college operates from Ram Hospital in Kisii, next to the Kisii Law Courts, and is a KNEC examination centre.
context.description: Ram Training College is a privately owned technical and vocational college in Kisii County, licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0041/2017, first registered on 16 February 2017 with a licence valid to 6 June 2029. Its accredited programme portfolio combines KNEC examined qualifications with competency-based TVET CDACC qualifications. At KNEC level the register records a craft course in social development and diploma courses in nutrition and dietetics and in social work and community development. At CDACC level it records community health and perioperative theatre technology at both Level 5 and Level 6, indicating progression routes within the health sciences. The college's own website prints its address as Ram Hospital Kisii, next to Kisii Law Courts, together with the telephone +254721332105 and the mailbox info.ramcollege@gmail.com, and states that the college is a KNEC examination centre and is accredited by the Nursing Council of Kenya.

context.description: Ramogi Institute of Advanced Technology (RIAT) is a pioneer public technical training institute that opened in 1971 after the local RIAT community and the people of Kenya raised funds in unison to build its initial infrastructure on RIAT Hills, Kisumu County, on the eastern shores of Lake Victoria. It operates as a public middle-level technical training institute under the TVET Act, 2013 and is listed by TVETA in its accredited register as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0024/2016, licensed to 24 April 2031. Teaching is organised across departments including Mechanical & Automotive, Building & Civil Engineering, Business Studies, Computing & Informatics, Applied Science, Electrical & Electronics, Agriculture & Environmental, Health Science, Liberal Studies, Fashion Design and Cosmetology, and Hospitality & Tourism, spanning artisan, craft, diploma and higher-diploma awards examined by KNEC, NITA and TVET CDACC. Selected as a Center of Excellence under the GoK and Devotra Netherlands projects, the institute houses state-of-the-art training equipment and serves as a model technology hub for the region, and it also runs short courses, a driving school, RPL and dual-TVET programmes. Students use a live online student portal, and the institute maintains a Quality Management System aligned to ISO 9001:2015.

about: Ramogi Institute of Advanced Technology (RIAT) is a public Technical and Vocational College which the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority lists in its accredited-institution register as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0024/2016, in Kisumu County, with a licence valid to 24 April 2031. Its accredited table spans automotive, electrical, agricultural, business, co-operative, laboratory-technology and solar-photovoltaic training from artisan through diploma level.
description: Ramogi Institute of Advanced Technology, trading as RIAT, is a public technical and vocational institution listed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority in its register of accredited institutions under TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0024/2016, with a licence valid to 24 April 2031 and a status of Registered and Licensed; the register places it in Kisumu County. The register's course table records twenty accredited awards. Engineering and construction trades are examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council, whose artisan award is motor vehicle mechanics, whose craft awards include automotive engineering, electrical and electronics technology in both the power and telecommunication options, science laboratory technology and general agriculture, and whose diploma awards include automotive engineering, electrical and electronics engineering (power), agriculture, entrepreneurship development and co-operative management. Business provision is examined by the same council at craft and diploma level in business management, human resource management, sales and marketing and supply chain management, and the National Industrial Training Authority examines the solar photovoltaic installation trade test. Competency-based training under the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council adds a level 6 electrical engineering diploma. Register levels were normalised to the schema vocabulary, with Craft rendered as Certificate and Trade Test rendered as Artisan, and CDACC level 6 recorded as Diploma. The institute's own website carries a Contact page that prints info@ramogiinstitute.ac.ke and a Gmail fallback beside the telephone +254 734 251 622 and the postal address P.O. Box 1738-40100 Kisumu, and that institutional address is recorded here.

context.description: Rarieda Technical & Vocational College appears in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as a public technical and vocational college (TVC) in Siaya County, in the Nyanza region, and the register carries it under two entries, TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0025/2023 and TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0026/2023, both registered on 31 July 2023 with licences expiring on 30 July 2028 under the status registered and licensed; the two register rows split one course table across them and have been merged and de-duplicated by course and level in this record. Sixty-seven distinct accredited programmes are listed: eight artisan awards, comprising KNEC artisan programmes in electrical installation, fashion design and garment making, hairdressing and beauty therapy, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, plumbing and food and beverage plus an NITA trade test in welding and fabrication; nine KNEC craft programmes rendered as Certificate in building technology, electrical and electronics technology (power), fashion design and garment making, general agriculture, information communication technology, social development, welding and fabrication, food and beverage production and service and automotive engineering; eight KNEC diploma programmes in information communication technology, social work and community development, agriculture, electrical and electronics engineering (power), fashion design and clothing technology, food and beverage production, sales and service management, building technology and catering and accommodation management; and forty-two TVET CDACC competency-based awards, fourteen at levels 3 and 4 rendered as Artisan, nineteen at level 5 rendered as Certificate and nine at level 6 rendered as Diploma. Register levels were normalised to the schema vocabulary, with Craft rendered as Certificate and trade tests rendered as Artisan. The register publishes no street address, postal address, telephone line or institutional email for the college, and the inherited domain rariedatvc.ac.ke could not be fetched in this pass, so no live website is recorded.

context.description: Riamo Technical & Vocational College is a public TVET institution operating as a Technical and Vocational College (TVC) under TVETA registration TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0041/2021, registered on 21 July 2021 with a licence valid to 27 August 2031. The TVETA register lists the college in Kisii County in the Nyanza region. Its published programme portfolio spans artisan, craft, diploma and competency-based (CBET) levels across agriculture and dairy, building and construction, electrical engineering, fashion, food technology, ICT, cosmetology and business. Box 2656-40200 Kisii off the Kisii-Kilgoris road; the institutional domain address is recorded here as the institutional e-mail.

context.description: Riara University is a private university on Raila Odinga Road, formerly Mbagathi Way, next to Nyayo Highrise Estate in Nairobi, founded in 2012 by Daniel and Eddah Gachukia as a continuation of the Riara Group of Schools begun in 1974. The university states that it is accredited by the Commission for University Education and teaches certificate, diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate programmes through its schools of business, education, communication and international relations. The course list covers a Master of Arts in International Relations and Diplomacy, bachelors degrees in business administration, computer science, education, Kiswahili, religious studies, international relations and communication and multimedia journalism, higher and professional diplomas in business, procurement, social entrepreneurship, ethical hacking and mobile application development, diplomas in international relations, procurement, leadership, education and the Certificate in Teaching International Curricula. All awards are examined internally by the university senate, so every entry carries an internal examination body. The university also runs KASNEB professional awards (CPA, CS, ATD), ICDL, the Teacher Professional Development Programme and professional-development short courses, which carry no level in the Schologic vocabulary and are therefore recorded in this description only.

context.about: Riara University is a private chartered university in Nairobi, Kenya, founded by educationists Daniel Gachukia and Eddah Gachukia, who established the Riara Group of Schools in 1974. The university began offering higher education in 2012 and was granted its Charter by President William Ruto on 19 March 2025. It is organised into six schools covering law, business, computing sciences, international relations and diplomacy, communication and multimedia journalism, and education.

context.description: Riara University operates from a campus on Raila Odinga Way, formerly Mbagathi Way, in Nairobi, under postal address 49940-00100. It is a private chartered university regulated by the Commission for University Education, which granted its Charter on 19 March 2025 after more than a decade of accredited operation since 2012. Teaching is organised across six schools offering undergraduate degrees, masters programmes, diplomas, certificates and professional short courses, with the official catalogue listing 33 programmes. The university also maintains a Moodle-based Virtual Campus for open, distance and e-learning and is building a 15-acre smart campus at Konza Technopolis as its planned main campus.

personal_contacts.profile_summary: Second Chancellor of Riara University and the first woman to hold the office, installed in 2025. Former U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for African Affairs (2005-2009) and U.S. Ambassador to South Africa; President and CEO of 50 Ventures and Duignan Distinguished Visiting Fellow at the Hoover Institution, Stanford University. Chancellor is a ceremonial office; the leadership page publishes the office address chancellor@riarauniversity.ac.ke.

Vice Chancellor of Riara University and chair of the Management Board. Holds a PhD in Microelectronic Engineering and Semiconductor Device Physics from the University of Surrey and was previously Principal of the Nairobi Campus at Kenya Methodist University from 2010. The leadership page publishes the office address vc@riarauniversity.ac.ke; no direct line is published.

Deputy Vice Chancellor for Academic Affairs, overseeing all academic programmes and standards of teaching and learning, with over 25 years of experience in curriculum development and quality assurance. The leadership page publishes the office address dvc.academic@riarauniversity.ac.ke; no direct line is published.

Listed on the Riara University Management Board as Assistant Registrar, the office handling academic records, registration and examination administration. No personal email or direct line is published; reachable via the university switchboard and general address.

about: Riara University is a private chartered university in Nairobi, Kenya, founded by educationists Daniel Gachukia and Eddah Gachukia, who established the Riara Group of Schools in 1974. The university began offering higher education in 2012 and was granted its Charter by President William Ruto on 19 March 2025. It is organised into six schools covering law, business, computing sciences, international relations and diplomacy, communication and multimedia journalism, and education.
description: Riara University operates from a campus on Raila Odinga Way, formerly Mbagathi Way, in Nairobi, under postal address 49940-00100. It is a private chartered university regulated by the Commission for University Education, which granted its Charter on 19 March 2025 after more than a decade of accredited operation from 2012. Teaching is organised across six schools offering undergraduate degrees, masters programmes, diplomas, certificates and professional short courses, with the official catalogue listing 33 programmes. The university states its mission as providing holistic education that enables each student to realise their full potential, and its vision as being a centre of excellence in scholarship, research and human resource development. A 15-acre campus is under development at Konza Technopolis, presented as the future main campus while Nairobi remains the active teaching campus.

context.description: Riatirimba Technical and Vocational College, which styles itself RTVC, is a public technical and vocational college located in Gesusu, Nyaribari Masaba Constituency, Kisii County, in Kenya's Nyanza region. It is fully registered under TVETA with registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0016/2021, and the TVETA register shows registration on 28 January 2021, a licence valid to 7 May 2031 and a status of 'Registered and Licensed', with category TVC and public ownership. The college offers artisan, craft and diploma programmes examined by KNEC alongside TVET CDACC competency-based Level 4 courses in trades such as carpentry and joining, electrical installation, plumbing, welding, fashion design and cosmetology. Its own site describes training in fields including mechanical engineering, computing, hospitality and business studies, with an emphasis on practical, industry-relevant skills.

context.about: Rift Koders Training Institute, which trades as RiftKoders, is a private technical and vocational college in Nakuru, Nakuru County, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0176/2024 with a licence valid to 28 October 2029. context.description: Rift Koders Training Institute is registered by the TVETA as a private Technical and Vocational College under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0176/2024, registered on 29 October 2024 with a licence valid to 28 October 2029 in Nakuru County. The college trades as RiftKoders and describes itself as a coding school that blends creativity with learning for learners from about five years old through to adults, offering a progressive Kodarit curriculum affiliated to the Finnish education provider of that name, digital literacy, a full-stack development programme and a cyber security course. Its TVETA accredited programme list contains two qualifications, Cyber Security at CDACC Level 5 and Cyber Security at CDACC Level 6, both assessed by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council. Classes are advertised in physical, full-day laboratory and live online formats, and enrolment runs through an online admission portal on hub.riftkoders.com; because no learning-management-system URL is published, e-learning and distance delivery are recorded as implied rather than verified. The institute's own contact page currently displays only unused WordPress template placeholders (a Brooklyn, New York address, example.com email addresses and US phone numbers), which were treated as placeholder content and not recorded as institutional data; a third-party directory (Cybo) lists the institute as a computer-training business at the corner of Masaai Avenue and Digo Road, Nakuru. The institute's staff page lists Purvi Shah as Executive Director, but no direct contact route is published for her, so no personal contact is recorded.

context.description: Rift Valley Institute of Business Studies is a private Technical and Vocational College registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0056/2016, with a licence valid to 13 October 2027 and the register status 'Registered and Licensed'. The register places it in Nakuru County under private ownership; a separate public entry, Rift Valley Institute of Science and Technology Kericho Town Campus, is a different institution with its own registration. Although the registered name points to business studies, the TVETA course table is one of the broadest held by a private college, with more than eighty course entries grouped at TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council Levels 4, 5 and 6. Provision covers building and civil works, electrical and electronics, automotive and mechanical engineering, medical engineering and pharmaceutical technology, community health, counselling and health records, business and supply chain management, marketing, human resource management, accountancy, library and information studies, journalism and digital media, information communication technology, cyber security and artificial intelligence, hospitality and baking, fashion, cosmetology and interior design, agriculture and agripreneurship, and social work. Level 4 entries are artisan-level trade qualifications, Level 5 entries are certificate-level, and Level 6 entries are diploma-level awards. The institute's own website prints the mailbox admin@rvibs.ac.ke in its Contacts block and again in its graduation notice, beside the Nakuru Town campuses and the telephone lines 0715 111101, 0715 111102 and 0715 111103; that printed address is recorded here as the institutional e-mail.

Box 103-40404, Rongo, and the office telephones: Admissions Office +254 794 781 865 and +254 794 781 551, Office of the Vice Chancellor +254 704 515 415, Registrar (Academic Affairs) +254 718 579 246 and a WhatsApp enquiries line 0101 513 256; the Admissions line +254 794 781 865 is recorded here. The homepage carries a spam-injection snippet of third-party casino/adware text around footer content, which suggests a site-integrity issue worth a maintenance check, but the domain itself serves the university. CUE's accredited programme register as at 31 July 2026 records 65 Rongo University programmes, of which the bachelors awards shown here cover linguistics, media and communication, criminology, political science and public administration, early childhood and primary education, special needs education, hotel and hospitality management, fashion design and textile technology, agricultural education and extension, applied statistics, project planning and economics, all examined internally. The university runs a Moodle-based e-learning platform at https://elearning.rongovarsity.ac.ke together with an e-learning administration page on its main site.

context.about: RVIST - Kuresoi Campus is a public technical and vocational college in Kuresoi, Nakuru County, Kenya, operating as a campus of the Rift Valley Institute of Science and Technology. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as a TVC institution and trains students in competency-based technical and business programmes.
context.description: RVIST - Kuresoi Campus appears in the TVET Authority register of accredited institutions under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0028/2024, registered on 29 October 2024 with a licence valid to 28 October 2029 and a status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The register classifies it as a public Technical and Vocational College (TVC) located in Nakuru County. Its accredited programme list, as published by the regulator, covers CDACC competency-based qualifications at Levels 4 and 5 in electrical installation, cosmetology, plumbing, business management and information communication technology. Re-search pass 2026-11-09 (G22): parent-body evidence remains uncorroborated - a vetted TVETA-derived listing for the parent Rift Valley Institute Of Science And Technology (TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0002/2018, Nakuru) was fetched and confirms the main institute's Nakuru registration, address P.O Box 7182 - 20100 Nakuru and programme table at campus level, but publishes no Kuresoi campus mention, and the rvist.ac.ke parent domain does not resolve (DNS failure); keyed listing-hub probes for the campus name returned extract timeouts. No campus-specific corroboration was fetched this pass; campus-specific contact and location values remain uncorroborated and the registry row stands unchanged. The regulator's register publishes no street address, postal address or separate contact details for the Kuresoi site, so the physical address and town fields are recorded as unknown here rather than guessed.

context.description: St Augustine's Catechists' Centre is a private religious catechetical training institution in Mathari, Nyeri County, established by the Consolata Missionaries in 1904 and owned and administered by the Catholic Archdiocese of Nyeri. Its own Facebook page, 'Catechetical Centre Mathari - Nyeri', states that it offers catechetical training to candidates from all the dioceses of Kenya and even outside Kenya, with the purpose of spiritual formation of catechists. The Star reported on 1 July 2026 that a Kenya Prisons Service catechist completed a two-year diploma in catechesis at the centre before employment as a catechist at Maragua Parish. The vetted directory page on africabizinfo places the centre on Mathari/Ihururu Road, 1961-10100 Nyeri, and lists a telephone line (+254 2023289960) and a fax number whose hosting rows are unaffiliated; the directory is used as a last-resort source with only its address rows carried. context.description: St Elizabeth Megun Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre at Megun in Uasin Gishu County, Kenya, recorded in the TVETA register as registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0002/2022 in the VTC category under public ownership. The register records a registration date of 27 January 2022, an expiry date of 26 January 2027 and a registration status of Registered and Licensed. Its registered programmes are NITA trade-test artisan courses in tailoring and dressmaking. The centre has also been designated by the county government as one of its Kanetik VTCs of excellence, specialising in plumbing, and was listed among the Uasin Gishu VTCs earmarked as small-scale NYS training hubs under the national NYS Mashinani partnership. In 2026 the KCB Foundation, in partnership with the County Government of Uasin Gishu, ran vocational training scholarship interviews in the county that included the Megun centre. The centre publishes no website, no e-learning platform and no social media presence, so public information about it comes from the regulator and news coverage.

context.about: ST John Paul II Institute School of Engineering is a private technical and vocational college in Kitui County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0038/2022. It specialises in electrical, automotive, plumbing and welding engineering training examined by KNEC and NITA.
context.description: ST John Paul II Institute School of Engineering is a private Technical and Vocational College registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0038/2022 on 27 July 2022. The regulator's register records its licence as Registered and Licensed with an expiry date of 26 July 2027 and lists eleven accredited engineering awards. The awards run from artisan certificates and NITA trade tests in electrical installation, plumbing, motor vehicle mechanics and welding and fabrication, through KNEC craft certificates in automotive engineering, electrical and electronics technology (power) and plumbing, to KNEC diplomas in automotive engineering and electrical and electronics engineering (power). Following the Schologic level-normalisation convention, the four NITA Trade Test awards are recorded at Artisan level, the three KNEC Craft awards at Certificate level and the two KNEC Diplomas at Diploma level, giving eleven distinct awards after duplicate rows were removed. The regulator's record publishes the institution's name in upper case, while the database retains its own title-case trading name. No institutional website, e-mail address, telephone line or street address was published on the regulator's record, so those fields remain null rather than guessed.

context.description: St Kizito Vocational Training Institute, branded St. Kizito VTI Technical College, is a mission-driven vocational training institution in Githurai (Githurai-Kimbo/Mwihoko area) on the Nairobi-Kiambu border, operating under the Archdiocese of Nairobi. Founded in 1986 with the support of the Italian NGO AVSI and Fr. Valerio Valeri, it focuses on holistic technical, entrepreneurial and professional skills training that empowers less-privileged youth for employment and self-reliance. The institute offers industry-driven programmes in automotive technology, electrical installation and electronics, carpentry and cabinet making, catering, cyber-security, computer packages and driving, with tuition around KSh 25,000 per year for most one-year trades and compulsory industrial attachment for trainees. It is registered and licensed by TVETA (currently under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0257/2025 and previously TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0008/2019), and its trainees sit CDACC and NITA trade tests. The institute also runs a live online learning platform at e-learning.stkizito.ac.ke offering free and paid self-paced courses with verifiable certificates, and collaborates with partners such as KOICA and GIZ on green-skills and women-focused training.

context.description: St. Paul's University TVET Centre (registered as St. Paul's University TVET Institute - Limuru Campus) is a private Technical and Vocational College located along Limuru Road in Limuru, Kiambu County. It is registered and licensed by TVETA under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0182/2024 (registered 2024-10-29, licence valid to 2029-10-28), with sister TVET campuses in Nairobi (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0086/2024) and Nakuru (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0181/2024). The institute offers Competency-Based Education and Training (CBET) programmes organised into basic, common and core unit clusters, examined by TVET-CDACC, St. Paul's University (internal), NITA, KASNEB, HRMPEB and KISEB across health sciences, business, ICT, cosmetology, communication, social sciences and theology. Programmes ladder from Bridging/Level 3 through Artisan/Level 4 and Certificate/Level 5 to Diploma/Level 6, delivered in Regular and Evening classes with intakes every January, May and August at the Limuru (Main), Nairobi and Nakuru campuses. Learners benefit from CBET modularised market-driven courses, affordable and flexible fee payment, credit transfer, timely results processing, and access to university facilities such as hostels, labs, workshops and the cafeteria.

context.description: St. Clare of Assisi Training Institute is recorded in the TVET Authority register as a private Technical and Vocational College in Turkana County, registered on 19 June 2017 under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0105/2017 and shown as Registered and Licensed on the 24 October 2026 register snapshot with the licence valid to 25 January 2028. The college sits at Kakuma next to the Kakuma Mission Hospital, along the Lodwar - Lokichogio Road, with postal address P.O. Box 26 - 30501 and telephone +254 713 219909. Its register-approved offering comprises craft certificate programmes in Information Communication Technology (examined by KASNEB), Accountancy and Food and Beverage Production and Service (KNEC), plus NITA trade-test artisan training in hairdressing, beauty therapy, tailoring and dressmaking, each intake capped at about 30 trainees. The institute served as one of three training centres in the GIZ Sustainable Economic Development and E4d/Soga Programme implemented by CAP Youth Empowerment Institute in Kakuma Refugee Camp and Kalobeyei Settlement, a project completed in 2021 that trained refugees and host-community youth in technical, vocational and occupational skills. A college website, stclarekakuma.org, is listed for the institute and indexed pages on it publish Early Childhood Development and Education (ECDE) qualification information, though the domain could not be reached live during research.

context.description: St. Clare's Kaplong School of Nursing operates alongside St. Clare's Kaplong Mission Hospital at Kaplong in Bomet County, on the Narok-Maai road corridor near Sotik. The school's own pages state that new nursing students were enrolled in March 2025 with a further intake planned for September 2025, and that trainees are enrolled for the Diploma in Kenya Registered Community Health Nursing accredited by the Nursing Council of Kenya. Alongside the diploma the school advertises a shorter Caregiver course, open to applicants with a minimum of a D plain at KCSE, which leads to a certificate on successful completion and is presented as preparation for elderly, patient and home-based care work. Its teaching resources are grouped in a Nursing Resource Centre comprising a library with books, journals and online databases, clinical guidelines and e-learning modules, a clinical simulation laboratory with mannequins and simulation software, a skills laboratory for practical nursing procedures, and computer access for research and simulation. The school publishes the telephone line 0706 728 296 and the email address principalnursingkaplong@gmail.com, and identifies itself on the same page as St. Clare's Kaplong School of Health Sciences.

description: Sabatia Technical and Vocational College appears in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as a public technical and vocational college in Kakamega County, registered on 19 July 2017 under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0039/2017 with a licence shown as expiring on 25 March 2029 in 'Registered and Licensed' status. The regulator's institution record carries thirty course rows, of which twenty-nine are distinct KNEC awards once duplicate course-and-level pairs are removed; the remaining row is a KASNEB professional accountancy award for Certified Public Accountants, which does not map onto the artisan-to-higher-diploma levels used in this schema and is therefore recorded only in the accreditations list. The accredited portfolio is unusually broad for a sub-county college, spanning automotive, building and electrical engineering at craft and diploma level, business and co-operative management, accountancy, project management, human resource management, supply chain management, secretarial studies, information communication technology, fashion design and garment making, masonry, plumbing, motor vehicle mechanics, food and beverage, and hairdressing and beauty therapy. This range suggests a mature, multi-departmental public college serving Western Kenya's larger secondary-school leaver population rather than a single-trade centre. No institutional website, e-mail address, telephone line or street-level address is published in the sources fetched during this run, so those identity fields remain null or unknown.

context.description: Shang Tao Media Art College is a privately owned media arts institution registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0016/2015, first registered on 17 February 2015 with a licence valid to 3 May 2028 and a status of Registered and Licensed. The college occupies the entire 15th floor (main office) plus the mezzanine, 1st and 16th floors of Hazina Towers on Utalii Lane in Nairobi's central district, accessible from Uhuru Highway or through University Way adjacent to Anniversary Towers. Its published portfolio comprises four professional development certificates in 3D Animation and Film, Graphic Design, Photography and Video Production, and a two-year Higher National Diploma in 3D Animation and Film with a credit value of 240 that is validated by BTEC Pearson and equivalent to a Foundation Degree on the UK RQF qualifications framework. Training is project based and hands on, delivered in dedicated computer laboratories through assessor-led demonstrations, workshops, tutorials, independent study, assignments, master classes and guest speakers, with flexible timings and state of the art fully equipped facilities. The HND also offers progression to the final year of a degree programme, and the college website maintains progression pathways, international students and student portfolio pages.

context.description: Shanzu Teachers Technical Training College is a public TVET institution in Mombasa County, Coast region, operating publicly as Shanzu Diploma Teachers' Training College on a 45-hectare site along the Mombasa–Malindi road near Shimo La Tewa, about 16 km north of Mombasa Island. TVETA registers it as SHANZU TEACHERS TECHNICAL TRAINING COLLEGE under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0006/2020, first registered on 23 January 2020 with a licence valid to 5 September 2030, and KUCCPS lists it as SHANZU TTTC. The college opened in May 1967, formed from the amalgamation of four smaller teachers' training colleges (Coast, Bura, Mutune and Ribe), and initially trained P1, P2 and P3 teachers. It now trains DPTE and ECDE teachers and offers diploma and certificate courses in business, ICT, project management, supply chain and community development, examined by KNEC, KASNEB, NITA, ICM and IBM alongside internally examined certificate courses. The student population has grown from the initial 127 students in 1967 to about 850 students today.
