context.description: The University of Embu is a public chartered university located along the Meru-Nairobi Highway, opposite Kangaru High School and about 4 km from Embu town, in Embu County, Kenya. It traces its origins to the Embu Agricultural Staff Training College founded in 1947, was renamed Embu Institute of Agriculture in 1968, became a constituent college of the University of Nairobi in 2011, and was awarded its charter as a fully-fledged public university on 7 October 2016. Academics are organised into schools of Agriculture, Pure and Applied Sciences, Business and Economics, Education and Social Sciences, Law and Nursing alongside a TVET Institute, offering senate-examined undergraduate degrees, postgraduate programmes through the Directorate of Postgraduate Studies, and TVET certificate and diploma courses. The university's Directorate of Open, Distance and e-Learning delivers programmes online and through blended learning, supported by a live Moodle-based e-learning portal at e-learning.embuni.ac.ke. KUCCPS lists 41 government-sponsored programmes at the institution, and the university is ISO 9001:2015 certified and listed by the Commission for University Education among Kenya's public chartered universities.

The institute publishes its own programmes catalogue, which sets out 46 offerings running from Level 4 artisan certificates through Level 7 higher diplomas, alongside KNEC craft certificates and diplomas and two KASNEB professional qualifications. Its contact page gives a physical address along the Embu-Meru Highway with postal code 6-60100 Embu, telephone 0115791601 and email uoemtveti@embuni.ac.ke, and it operates a separate student portal for enrolled trainees. The Principal is named on the institute website as Dr Ann G. Waruita.

context.description: Upperhill College of Professional Studies is recorded in the TVETA register of accredited institutions as a private technical and vocational college in Nakuru County, registered on 29 July 2025 under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0153/2025 with a licence valid to 28 July 2030 and a status of 'Registered and Licensed'. context.about: Vera Beauty and Fashion College Eldoret Branch is a private technical and vocational college in Uasin Gishu County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0082/2017. It trains cosmetology, hairdressing, beauty therapy and fashion design and technology at KNEC, NITA and TVET CDACC award levels.
context.description: Vera Beauty and Fashion College Eldoret Branch is the Eldoret branch of the Vera Beauty College group, registered separately by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0082/2017 on 12 April 2017. The regulator's register records its licence as Registered and Licensed with an expiry date of 18 July 2030 and lists thirty-eight accredited award rows that are heavily repeated. After de-duplication by course, level and exam body the register resolves to eleven distinct awards spanning fashion design and garment making, hairdressing and beauty therapy, cosmetology, fashion design technology and interior design. Following the Schologic level-normalisation convention, KNEC Craft and CDACC Level 5 awards are recorded at Certificate level, KNEC Diploma at Diploma level, and NVCET, NITA Trade Test and CDACC Levels 3 and 4 at Artisan level. The live site verabeautycollege.com was fetched and confirmed to be Vera Beauty College, advertising cosmetology, beauty therapy, hairdressing and fashion design and creative arts, so it is recorded as the institution's website. The regulator records separate registrations for Vera Beauty and Fashion College Thika (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0046/2024), Vera Beauty and Fashion College Mombasa (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0047/2024) and Vera Beauty College Nairobi (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0280/2016), which are distinct records from this Eldoret branch.

context.description: Vera Beauty and Fashion College, Mombasa is a private technical and vocational institution operating in Mombasa County, Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority lists it under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0047/2024 with a licence expiring on 24 April 2029 and the status Registered and Licensed. Its accredited programme table carries three competency-based awards: Cosmetology at level 5, Cosmetology at level 6 and Fashion Design at level 6, each examined by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council. The college group's own contact page carries a dedicated Mombasa Branch block giving the campus at Ambalal House, Mezzanine Floor, Nkurumah Road, Mombasa, with its own telephone line 0113 820702 distinct from the Nairobi head-office numbers, and the group mailbox info@verabeautycollege.com. That branch address sits in Mombasa, matching the Mombasa County recorded on the regulator register. The register itself publishes no street address, postal details, telephone line or institutional email for this campus, and no e-learning or distance-learning provision is published on any source reviewed.

context.description: Vera Technical Training College is a privately owned Technical and Vocational College in Nakuru County, Kenya, registered by the TVETA on 23 January 2020 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0032/2020 with a licence valid to 16 May 2030 and the status Registered and Licensed. The register's accredited table lists a KNEC craft award in food and beverage production and service, KNEC diplomas in catering and accommodation management, fashion design and clothing technology, and information communication technology, plus an NITA trade-test course in plumbing and pipe fitting, recorded respectively at Certificate, Diploma and Artisan level. The college operates an official website at https://veratechnical.com/, which states that it was established in 1998 in response to demand for training in cosmetology, hairdressing, beauty therapy, modelling, fashion and instructor training, and that its provision has since expanded into hospitality, ICT, caregiving, plumbing, electrical installation and barista skills. The site publishes its address as Prime Plaza, 4th Floor, along Mburu Gichua Road, Nakuru, and its telephone line as +254 713 750 000, while its own social posts and the SchoolAndCollegeListings directory place the campus at Vera Technical Plaza on Oginga Odinga Road opposite Mau View Hotel, Nakuru, and advertise the same number and the veratechnical.com domain. The institution is described by the Makeup brand directory as the technical arm of the Vera Beauty and Fashion College brand.

context.about: Vision Empowerment Training Institute - Mombasa Campus is a campus of a private Technical and Vocational College registered by TVETA as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0066/2021 and licensed in Mombasa County, offering KNEC artisan and craft awards in electrical, fashion, food and beverage, motor vehicle, plumbing, salesmanship and ICT disciplines.
context.description: Vision Empowerment Training Institute - Mombasa Campus appears in the TVETA register as a private Technical and Vocational College in Mombasa County under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0066/2021, registered on 21 July 2021 and licensed to 26 July 2031 with a status of Registered and Licensed. The register lists eighteen course rows which de-duplicate to eleven distinct awards: six artisan awards in Electrical Installation, Fashion Design and Garment Making, Food and Beverage, Motor Vehicle Mechanics, Plumbing and Salesmanship, plus five craft awards in Electrical and Electronics Technology (Power), Electrical and Electronics Technology, Information Communication Technology, Information Technology and Social Development, all examined by KNEC. The institute's own website describes a multi-campus operation with Nairobi, Mombasa, Kitengela and Isinya campuses and gives the Mombasa campus as being along Mtambo Road, behind Equity Afya and near New Naivas supermarket, with the campus telephone line +254724 924 242 and the institute e-mail info@veti.ac.ke. The register carries separate entries for the Nairobi campus (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0149/2016), Kitengela (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0013/2022) and Isinya (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0053/2026), so this record covers only the Mombasa campus registration. Student numbers and campus facilities are not published.

Vision Stars Training Institute is a privately owned technical and vocational college in Eldoret, Uasin Gishu County, registered and licensed by TVETA under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0105/2018 since July 2018. The institute operates from Moi Street off Uganda Road, opposite the General Post Office in Eldoret town, with studyinkenya listing a Nature House campus. Its programme portfolio centres on KNEC-examined certificate and diploma courses in business management, information and communication technology, secretarial studies, and social work and community development. The institute also lists professional and language-oriented offerings such as the Accounting Technicians Diploma and certificate courses in information studies, serving trainees seeking market-aligned business and technical skills in the North Rift region.

name: Visualdo Institute

context.about: Visualdo Institute is a private Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County registered by the TVET Authority, teaching media production, art and design, technology, health, business and hospitality programmes at certificate and diploma level and describing itself as a creative and technical college.
context.description: The TVET Authority register lists the institution as Visualdo Institute under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0037/2023, registered on 4 May 2023 with a licence valid to 3 May 2028 as a private Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County, and records one accredited programme, Digital Journalism at CDACC Level 6. The college's own website, visualdo.ac.ke, trades as Visualdo Institute with the motto 'Turning Passion into Professions' and publishes a much wider catalogue across six schools: media (film production, photography, videography, deejaying, content creation, journalism and live streaming), art and design (animation 2D and 3D, graphic design, fine art, UI and UX design, print technology, interior design and fashion), technology (digital marketing, web and full-stack development, CISCO, cyber security, data analytics, electrical installation, electronics servicing, ICT, networking and CCTV, plumbing and solar installation), health sciences (health services support and certified nursing assistant, community health, clinical support, health records and nutrition), business (management, administration, marketing, procurement, human resources, accounting, CPA and ATD, project management and office administration) and hospitality (hospitality management, event management, hairdressing and beauty therapy). Featured certificate programmes such as videography and photography are advertised at three months and diplomas such as fine art, animation 2D and 3D, graphic design, film production and digital marketing at one to two years, with monthly fee instalments; because the website states no examining body per programme and the register lists only one accredited course, those additional programmes are described rather than recorded as course entries. The college displays TVETA, TVET CDACC, NITA and ICM accreditation marks and advertises a Nakuru campus opening alongside its Nairobi campus; the register publishes only the county, so the street address is left empty and the WhatsApp line published on the site is recorded as the telephone contact.

context.about: Vitech Training Institute is a private technical and vocational college in Siaya County registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0010/2018, recorded as Registered and Licensed with a licence expiry date of 23 October 2028. Its approved portfolio spans artisan, certificate and diploma awards across electrical, automotive, business, hospitality, cosmetology, land surveying and ICT disciplines.
context.description: Vitech Training Institute appears in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as a private TVC in Siaya County, registered on 12 January 2018 under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0010/2018 and recorded as Registered and Licensed with a licence expiry date of 23 October 2028. The register's course table lists twenty-two approved awards: two artisan-level KNEC awards (electrical installation and motor vehicle mechanics), two craft-level KNEC awards (business management and social development), one KNEC diploma (business management), and seventeen competency-based awards examined by TVET CDACC. Level normalisation follows the convention used across this research programme: KNEC craft awards and CDACC Level 5 awards are recorded at schema level Certificate, CDACC Level 3 and Level 4 awards at Artisan, and KNEC diploma and CDACC Level 6 awards at Diploma; where one subject is registered at two levels each row carries its level qualifier. The institute's own live site operates a Nairobi Campus and a Bondo Campus, publishes the Bondo campus at VTI Complex, Block B in Bondo Town with the lines +254 724 372 102 and +254 729 177 560, and carries the addresses info@vti.ac.ke and vitechinst@gmail.com. Bondo is a town in Siaya County, which matches the county recorded on the regulator register. The register entry itself publishes no website, e-mail address, telephone number or street address for this institute.

context.description: Vitech Training Institute appears in the TVET Authority register under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0246/2016, first registered on 14 July 2016 and licensed to 3 May 2028, as a private technical and vocational college in Nairobi County. The register lists four accredited awards: Business Administration, Electrical and Electronics Technology (Power) and Masonry at Craft level, and Mechanical Engineering at Diploma level, all examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council. Under the batch level convention, KNEC Craft awards are recorded as Certificate and the KNEC Diploma award as Diploma. The institute's own live site presents itself as Vitech Training Institute (VTI) with a Nairobi Campus and a Bondo Campus, locates its Nairobi operation in Nairobi CBD, and publishes the Nairobi lines +254 720 337 065 and +254 722 166 494 together with the addresses info@vti.ac.ke and vitechinst@gmail.com. A second, similarly named register entry (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0021/2019) in Nairobi carries Deregistered status, so the licensed entry above is the one recorded here. No e-learning portal URL is published despite the site's E-Learning Hub page, and no distance-learning accreditation appears on the register.

context.description: Voice International College (V.I.C) began in 2000 as VOSH Bible School (VBS), an initiative of the Voice of Salvation & Healing Church International in Kisumu, Kenya. It is registered by TVETA under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0084/2017 with a licence valid to 10 September 2030, and its registered award is Social Development at craft level examined by KNEC. Beyond the registered award, the college teaches Biblical Studies and Theology at diploma and certificate level and runs short professional-development courses such as Practical Ministry. The college states that it offers e-learning as an essential part of training and reports over 300 registered students and more than 20 years of training. Its main campus in Kisumu has been undergoing a facelift since 2022, and in February 2025 the college signed an MoU with Life Ministry.

context.description: Wanga Technical and Vocational College, which also brands itself WTVC, is recorded in the TVETA register as a public Technical and Vocational College in Kakamega County under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0025/2020, registered on 16 April 2020 with a licence valid to 14 July 2030 and the status Registered and Licensed. The regulator's course table holds twenty-four rows that reduce to twenty-two distinct qualifications, all examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council: eleven craft programmes recorded here at Certificate level and eleven diploma programmes, with duplicate rows for Building Technology and Supply Chain Management collapsed during this pass. Five programme titles are accredited at both craft and diploma level, namely building technology, human resource management, information communication technology, project management and water technology, and each retains a level qualifier so that neither award is lost. The college's own website states that it sits on a six-acre site along the Shianda-Butere road in Mumias East Sub County, was founded in 2016 through a partnership between the national government and the Mumias East Constituency Development Fund, admitted its first students on 6 September 2019 and was officially inaugurated on 25 October 2019. It publishes the postal address P.O. Box 78 - 50106 Shianda, the telephone line 0115052875 and the email address wangatechnical@gmail.com, all recorded here from the fetched about page; a separate directory lists different contact details, which were not adopted because the college's own domain is authoritative for its contacts. No named officer is published on the fetched pages, so the personal contacts list is empty.

context.about: Webuye West Technical and Vocational College is a public TVET institution under the Ministry of Education's State Department for TVET, located in Webuye West Constituency of Bungoma County, Kenya. It opened its doors in 2019 and is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0005/2020. courses.name: Hair Dressing and Beauty Therapy Level 3

context.description: Webuye West Technical and Vocational College is a publicly owned Technical and Vocational College in Bungoma County recorded on the TVET Authority register under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0005/2020, registered on 23 January 2020 with a licence valid to 9 March 2030 and a register status of 'Registered and Licensed'. Its own website states that the college opened in 2019 and that it sits in Webuye West Constituency next to Machakha market, 7.6 km from Matisi along the Webuye-Bungoma highway, 5.3 km from Bokoli market along the Sikata-Kimilili road and 7.1 km from Makhese market along the Misikhu-Webuye highway. The college organises teaching into eight academic departments: computing and informatics, business, electrical engineering, agriculture, mechanical engineering, building and civil engineering, fashion design and cosmetology, and food and beverages. Its published course catalogue lists competency-based programmes examined by TVET CDACC at Levels 3 to 6, including ICT technician, food production, fashion and design, business management, human resource management, supply chain management, agricultural extension, automotive, welding and fabrication, building technician, civil engineering, plumbing, electrical installation, electronics, food technology and science laboratory technology, alongside KASNEB Accounting Technicians Diploma and Certified Accounting Management Skills awards and six-month short courses in welding, hairdressing, beauty therapy, dressmaking and tailoring. The TVETA register separately lists 31 accredited KNEC artisan and craft programmes including building technology, electrical installation, fashion design and garment making, food and beverage, general agriculture, hairdressing and beauty therapy, motor vehicle technology, storekeeping and accountancy. The college states its vision to be a dynamic centre of excellence in technical and vocational education and training, research and industrial development, and publishes a Principal's office together with two deputies, a registrar, a finance officer and a procurement officer.

context.description: The TVET Authority register records Wigot School of Hospitality as a private Technical and Vocational College in Kisumu County under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0045/2023, registered on 4 May 2023 with a licence valid to 3 May 2028 and the status Registered and Licensed. The register lists four accredited qualifications: a KNEC artisan Food and Beverage award, KNEC craft certificates in Catering and Accommodation Operations and in Food and Beverage Production and Service, and a KNEC diploma in Food and Beverage Production, Sales and Service Management. The school's own website adds ICM diploma programmes in Culinary Arts and in Food and Beverage Service, plus one-month internal short courses in Pastry and Bakery and in Housekeeping, Laundry and Front Office Operations. Established in 2021, the school sits within the four-star Wigot Gardens boutique hotel in Kajulu Hills above the Mamboleo suburb of Kisumu, about four kilometres from the central business district, and states a mission to provide high-end hospitality training. It admits KCSE mean grade C- (and equivalent qualifications) for diploma courses, assists with local and international internship and job placement, and offers student accommodation, uniforms, and full-time or part-time study modes.

context.about: The Wildlife Research and Training Institute (WRTI) is a Kenyan state institute whose Training Division delivers competency-based certificate and diploma programmes in wildlife, conservation and fisheries from its Naivasha campus in Nakuru County. Training is offered through the institute's dedicated training website and links directly to its research centres, including the Inland Waters and Wetlands Research Center on the shores of Lake Naivasha.

Hippo Campsite conferencing and camping facility
context.description: The Wildlife Research and Training Institute is a Kenyan state institution whose Training Division runs competency-based diploma and certificate programmes, advertised on a dedicated training website at wrti.ac.ke. The institute states that its courses have been developed in liaison with TVET CDACC and relevant industry stakeholders, with minimum entry of D (plain) for certificate programmes and C- (minus) for diploma programmes. Training is supported by field facilities including a fish farm at the Inland Waters and Wetlands Research Center on the shores of Lake Naivasha, where students of the Diploma in Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences and the Certificate in Aquaculture carry out practical work. The institute also operates research centres, a conference and camping facility at Hippo Campsite, and Naivasha Wildlife Sanctuary. Official contacts published on the institute's website are P.O. Box 842-20117 Naivasha, telephone +254 700 000 321 and +254 731 919 465, and email wrti@wrti.go.ke. A complete published course catalogue and student enrolment totals were not available on the pages fetched, so only the two courses named in published text are recorded and estimated_student_count is null.

context.about: Wote Technical Training Institute is a public technical and vocational college 3 km from Wote town along the Wote-Makindu road in Makueni County, operating under the Ministry of Education's State Department for Technical and Vocational Education and Training and registered by TVETA since 2014. It trains in engineering, business, applied science, hospitality and CBET competency-based programmes, is governed by a Board of Governors, and states an ambition to become a National Polytechnic.
context.description: Wote Technical Training Institute (Wote TTI) is a public TVET institution operating under the Ministry of Education's State Department for Technical and Vocational Education and Training and registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0004/2014, registered on 17 November 2014 with a licence valid to 29 April 2031 and a status of Registered and Licensed. The institute sits 3 km from Wote town along the Wote-Makindu road, adjacent to Makueni Girls Secondary School and the County Public Works offices. Its motto is 'Excellence in Science, Innovation & Technology' and its stated vision is to be a technical training centre of excellence in business and technology for all sectors of the economy. It is governed by a Board of Governors with trainers provided by the national government, and reports having diversified into business studies, CBET competency-based courses, applied science and hospitality. Academic work is organised into mechanical engineering, computing and informatics, building and civil engineering, hospitality and tourism management, business, fashion design and cosmetology, and electrical and electronics departments. The TVETA register lists 80 accredited qualifications spanning KNEC diploma, craft and artisan trades, KASNEB accounting awards, NITA trade tests and TVET CDACC competency levels; the institute also runs a driving school and a Jitume digital-skills laboratory.

It trains in engineering, business, applied science, hospitality and CBET competency-based programmes, is governed by a Board of Governors, and states an ambition to become a National Polytechnic.
description: Wote Technical Training Institute (Wote TTI) is a public TVET institution operating under the Ministry of Education's State Department for Technical and Vocational Education and Training and registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0004/2014, registered on 17 November 2014 with a licence valid to 29 April 2031 and a status of Registered and Licensed. The institute sits 3 km from Wote town along the Wote-Makindu road, adjacent to Makueni Girls Secondary School and the County Public Works offices. Its motto is 'Excellence in Science, Innovation & Technology' and its stated vision is to be a technical training centre of excellence in business and technology for all sectors of the economy. It is governed by a Board of Governors with trainers provided by the national government, and reports having diversified into business studies, CBET competency-based courses, applied science and hospitality. Academic work is organised into mechanical engineering, computing and informatics, building and civil engineering, hospitality and tourism management, business, fashion design and cosmetology, and electrical and electronics departments. The TVETA register lists 80 accredited qualifications spanning KNEC diploma, craft and artisan trades, KASNEB accounting awards, NITA trade tests and TVET CDACC competency levels; the institute also runs a driving school and a Jitume digital-skills laboratory.

Learning is flexible, with full-time, part-time and short-course options, and site testimonials highlight church bookkeeping, computer applications and beauty short courses aimed at working learners.

Level normalisation follows the convention used across this research programme: NITA Trade Test and CDACC Level 3 awards are both recorded at schema level Artisan rather than collapsed into Certificate, and the examining body is preserved exactly as printed in the register. context.about: Zabibu Disability Technical and Vocational Training Institute is a specialized mission-driven center in Ruiru dedicated to empowering youth with disabilities through holistic vocational training and social rehabilitation.
context.description: Founded in 2005 by James and Irene Wagema, the Zabibu Disability Technical and Vocational Training Institute serves as a sanctuary for orphaned and vulnerable youth with physical and mental disabilities. Its mission is to move learners from dependency to independence by providing a safe, supportive environment for rehabilitation and practical skill development. The institute offers specialized vocational programs tailored to the needs of its students, fostering self-reliance and dignity through hands-on mastery of crafts and technical trades. Zabibu's unique value proposition is its holistic approach to disability empowerment, combining technical education with psycho-social support to ensure sustainable livelihoods for the marginalized.

context.description: ZETECH BUSINESS AND TECHNICAL INSTITUTE - STANBANK CAMPUS is recorded in the TVET Authority register as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0080/2016, a private Technical and Vocational College campus placed in Nairobi County. The register lists no street address, postal address, telephone line or email address specific to this campus and no campus website was located, so those fields are recorded as unknown rather than inherited from the Zetech group's other domains.

context.description: Zetech College - Pioneer House is registered by TVETA as a private Technical and Vocational College (TVC) in Nairobi County under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0151/2016, with registration dated 14 April 2016 and a licence valid to 18 February 2027. The campus occupies Pioneer House on Moi Avenue in the Starehe area of Nairobi's central business district, with directory listings also placing it on the second floor fronting Harambee Avenue. It belongs to the Zetech group of institutions, whose main site has since evolved into Zetech University, a chartered private university whose website lists the Pioneer Campus as part of its Nairobi CBD presence. The TVETA register records KNEC-examined artisan, craft and diploma awards in food and beverage, general agriculture, information communication technology, secretarial studies, human resource management and water technology (sanitation), while capacity listings for the same registration add KNEC business management, supply chain management and sales and marketing courses, ABE diplomas and a City and Guilds computer and software engineering diploma. Third-party campus profiles now also show university-level degree and certificate programmes delivered at the Pioneer campus under Zetech University.

context.description: Zuriel Technical Training Institute is a private Technical and Vocational College registered and licensed by TVETA under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0001/2024 (registered 15 May 2024, licence valid to 14 May 2029, status 'Registered and Licensed'), located in Eldoret, Uasin Gishu County. Its accredited programmes, confirmed by the TVETA register, are seven TVET CDACC competency-based courses spanning Computer Operations (Level 3), Caregiving (Level 4), Community Health (Levels 5 and 6), Counselling Psychology (Levels 5 and 6) and Healthcare Support Services (Level 5). Its website zuriel.ac.ke presents the institute as a career-oriented institution offering practical, skills-based training in healthcare and other technical and professional fields, but large parts of the site remain unconfigured template content: the contact block shows US placeholders (123 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10160; 929-242-6868; contact@info.com), and the About Us page still carries a 'Bobby Harris, Founder' web-skills template narrative, so no verified institutional email, phone, postal address or founder is published. The site runs a WordPress/LearnDash LMS at zuriel.ac.ke with course listings and self-paced online study messaging, though the main course-list shortcode renders unconfigured and the listed web-development titles are theme demo content rather than the CDACC programmes. Third-party directories covering the college (Yibuka, MyCyber) reproduce the TVETA register row only; MyCyber's WhatsApp numbers 254 753 152 007 and 254 751 947 700 belong to MyCyber's own service desk, not to Zuriel.
